import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import os from 'os';
import { adminDb } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';

export async function GET() {
    const hwid = process.env.MACHINE_HWID;
    
    if (!hwid) {
        return NextResponse.json({ 
            isValid: true, 
            tier: 'standard', 
            hwid: null,
            message: 'Modo Web/EstÃ¡ndar. No se detectÃ³ HWID fÃ­sico.' 
        });
    }

    try {
        const sysDir = path.join(os.homedir(), '.admincom_sys');
        if (!fs.existsSync(sysDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(sysDir, { recursive: true });
        }
        
        const cacheFile = path.join(sysDir, 'license_cache.json');
        let localData: any = null;

        if (fs.existsSync(cacheFile)) {
            try {
                localData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cacheFile, 'utf8'));
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Error parsing local cache file', e);
            }
        }

        const licenseKey = localData?.licenseKey;

        // Intentar validaciÃ³n online
        try {
            let licenseDoc = null;

            if (licenseKey) {
                const docSnap = await adminDb.collection('licenses').doc(licenseKey).get();
                if (docSnap.exists) {
                    licenseDoc = docSnap.data();
                }
            }
            
            if (!licenseDoc) {
                // Check by hwid in machineIds
                const snap = await adminDb.collection('licenses').where('machineIds', 'array-contains', hwid).get();
                if (!snap.empty) {
                    licenseDoc = snap.docs[0].data();
                }
            }

            if (licenseDoc) {
                // Verify status
                if (!licenseDoc.isActive) {
                    // Licencia desactivada â†’ modo freemium, sigue funcionando
                    return NextResponse.json({ isValid: true, tier: 'standard', hwid, message: 'Licencia suspendida. Operando en modo gratuito.' });
                }
                if (licenseDoc.expiresAt && licenseDoc.expiresAt < Date.now()) {
                    // SuscripciÃ³n vencida â†’ modo freemium, sigue funcionando
                    return NextResponse.json({ isValid: true, tier: 'standard', hwid, message: 'SuscripciÃ³n vencida. Operando en modo gratuito. Â¡Renueva para recuperar IA y OMNIPULSE!' });
                }
                if (!licenseDoc.machineIds || !licenseDoc.machineIds.includes(hwid)) {
                    // MÃ¡quina diferente: freemium tambiÃ©n, no bloqueamos
                    return NextResponse.json({ isValid: true, tier: 'standard', hwid, message: 'MÃ¡quina no registrada en esta licencia. Modo gratuito activo.' });
                }

                // Update local cache
                const newCache = {
                    licenseKey: licenseDoc.key,
                    machineId: hwid,
                    tier: 'pro',
                    lastChecked: Date.now()
                };
                fs.writeFileSync(cacheFile, JSON.stringify(newCache));

                return NextResponse.json({ 
                    isValid: true, 
                    tier: 'pro', 
                    hwid, 
                    message: 'Licencia vÃ¡lida online.' 
                });
            } else {
                // Sin licencia en Firestore â†’ modelo freemium, tier gratuito
                return NextResponse.json({
                    isValid: true,
                    tier: 'standard',
                    hwid,
                    message: 'Modo gratuito activo. Actualiza a PRO para desbloquear IA, OMNIPULSE y backup en la nube.'
                });
            }
        } catch (onlineError) {
            console.error('Online validation failed, trying offline fallback', onlineError);
            // Fallback to offline verification
            if (localData && localData.lastChecked && localData.machineId === hwid) {
                const daysPassed = (Date.now() - localData.lastChecked) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
                if (daysPassed <= 7) {
                    return NextResponse.json({ 
                        isValid: true, 
                        tier: 'pro', 
                        hwid, 
                        remainingDays: Math.max(0, Math.ceil(7 - daysPassed)),
                        message: 'Licencia vÃ¡lida offline (perÃ­odo de gracia).' 
                    });
                } else {
                    // Gracia offline expirada â†’ freemium, no bloqueamos
                    return NextResponse.json({ 
                        isValid: true, 
                        tier: 'standard', 
                        hwid, 
                        message: 'Modo gratuito activo. Reconecta a internet para verificar tu licencia PRO.' 
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        // Sin cache local ni Firestore â†’ freemium funcional
        return NextResponse.json({ 
            isValid: true, 
            tier: 'standard', 
            hwid, 
            message: 'Modo gratuito activo. Actualiza a PRO para desbloquear todas las funciones.' 
        });

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('License API Error:', error);
        return NextResponse.json({ 
            isValid: false, 
            tier: 'standard', 
            error: 'Error validando licencia en la mÃ¡quina' 
        }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireRole } from '@/lib/apiAuth';
import { adminDb } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';

// â”€â”€ Helper: generate license key ADMIN-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function generateKey(): string {
    const seg = () => Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();
    return `ADMIN-${seg()}-${seg()}-${seg()}`;
}

// â”€â”€ POST /api/licenses â€” Create a new license â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Requiere rol superadmin autenticado via cookie de sesiÃ³n
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
    const auth = requireRole(req, ['superadmin']);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

    try {
        const { clientName, email, maxMachines = 1, expiresAt = null } = await req.json();

        if (!clientName || !email) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'clientName y email son requeridos' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        const key = generateKey();

        await adminDb.collection('licenses').doc(key).set({
            key,
            clientName,
            email,
            maxMachines,
            machineIds: [],
            isActive: true,
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            expiresAt,   // null = licencia permanente
        });

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, key, clientName });
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[API/licenses POST]', err);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Error interno' }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

// â”€â”€ GET /api/licenses â€” List all licenses â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Requiere rol superadmin autenticado via cookie de sesiÃ³n
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
    const auth = requireRole(req, ['superadmin']);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

    try {
        const snap = await adminDb.collection('licenses').orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').get();
        const licenses = snap.docs.map((d: any) => d.data());
        return NextResponse.json({ licenses });
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[API/licenses GET]', err);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Error interno' }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

// â”€â”€ PATCH /api/licenses â€” Activate / Deactivate â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Requiere rol superadmin autenticado via cookie de sesiÃ³n
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
    const auth = requireRole(req, ['superadmin']);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

    try {
        const { key, isActive, resetMachines } = await req.json();

        if (!key) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'key requerida' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        const update: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (typeof isActive === 'boolean') update.isActive = isActive;
        if (resetMachines) update.machineIds = [];

        await adminDb.collection('licenses').doc(key).update(update);
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, key, ...update });
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[API/licenses PATCH]', err);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Error interno' }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
import { adminDb } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';
import { MercadoPagoConfig, Preference } from 'mercadopago';

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
    try {
        const body = await req.json();
        const { items, orderId, customer } = body;

        // 1. Fetch config from Firestore
        const settingsSnap = await adminDb.doc('settings/site_config').get();
        if (!settingsSnap.exists) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ConfiguraciÃ³n no encontrada' }, { status: 400 });
        }
        
        const configData = settingsSnap.data() as any;
        const accessToken = configData.mp_access_token;

        if (!accessToken) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'MercadoPago no estÃ¡ configurado por el administrador' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        // 2. Initialize MercadoPago SDK
        const client = new MercadoPagoConfig({ accessToken, options: { timeout: 5000 } });
        const preference = new Preference(client);

        // 3. Create Preference
        const response = await preference.create({
            body: {
                items: items.map((item: any) => ({
                    id: item.id,
                    title: item.name,
                    quantity: item.quantity,
                    unit_price: Number(item.price),
                    currency_id: 'MXN'
                })),
                payer: {
                    name: customer.name,
                    email: "cliente@ejemplo.com", // Puedes pedir email en el checkout despuÃ©s
                },
                external_reference: orderId,
                back_urls: {
                    success: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/catalogo?status=success`,
                    failure: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/catalogo?status=failure`,
                    pending: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/catalogo?status=pending`
                },
                auto_return: 'approved'
            }
        });

        return NextResponse.json({ preferenceId: response.id, init_point: response.init_point });
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Error MercadoPago create-preference:", error);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

ARCHIVO: src\app\api\mercadopago\webhook\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { adminDb } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';
import { MercadoPagoConfig, Payment } from 'mercadopago';

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
    try {
        const url = new URL(req.url);
        let type = url.searchParams.get('type') || url.searchParams.get('topic');
        let dataId = url.searchParams.get('data.id') || url.searchParams.get('id');

        // Si no vienen en los parÃ¡metros de la URL, intentamos leer del body JSON (Webhook estÃ¡ndar)
        if (!type || !dataId) {
            try {
                const body = await req.json();
                if (body) {
                    type = type || body.type || (body.action ? body.action.split('.')[0] : null);
                    dataId = dataId || (body.data?.id ? String(body.data.id) : (body.id ? String(body.id) : null));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                // No hay body JSON o no se pudo parsear
            }
        }

        if (type === 'payment' && dataId) {
            // 1. Fetch config from Firestore
            const settingsSnap = await adminDb.doc('settings/site_config').get();
            if (settingsSnap.exists) {
                const configData = settingsSnap.data() as any;
                const accessToken = configData.mp_access_token;

                if (accessToken) {
                    const client = new MercadoPagoConfig({ accessToken, options: { timeout: 5000 } });
                    const payment = new Payment(client);
                    
                    // Buscar detalles del pago
                    const paymentInfo = await payment.get({ id: dataId });
                    
                    if (paymentInfo.status === 'approved') {
                        const orderId = paymentInfo.external_reference;
                        if (orderId) {
                            // Marcar orden como PAGADA en Firebase
                            await adminDb.doc(`orders/${orderId}`).update({
                                status: 'paid',
                                paymentDetails: {
                                    provider: 'mercadopago',
                                    id: dataId,
                                    paidAt: new Date().toISOString()
                                }
                            });
                            console.log(`[MP Webhook] Orden ${orderId} marcada como PAGADA.`);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Error MercadoPago webhook:", error);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { networkInterfaces } from 'os';

export async function GET() {
    try {
        const nets = networkInterfaces();
        let localIp = '';

        // Prioridad 1: Buscar adaptadores LAN tÃ­picos (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x)
        for (const name of Object.keys(nets)) {
            for (const net of nets[name] || []) {
                if (net.family === 'IPv4' && !net.internal) {
                    if (net.address.startsWith('192.168.') || net.address.startsWith('10.')) {
                        localIp = net.address;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (localIp) break;
        }

        // Prioridad 2: Cualquier otra IPv4 no interna
        if (!localIp) {
            for (const name of Object.keys(nets)) {
                for (const net of nets[name] || []) {
                    if (net.family === 'IPv4' && !net.internal) {
                        localIp = net.address;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (localIp) break;
            }
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ 
            ip: localIp || '127.0.0.1',
            publicUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || process.env.APP_URL || null
        });
    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ ip: '127.0.0.1', error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

/**
 * @deprecated Usar /api/network/ip â€” esta ruta existe solo por compatibilidad.
 * La versiÃ³n canÃ³nica prioriza correctamente redes LAN (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x).
 */
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { networkInterfaces } from 'os';

export async function GET() {
    try {
        const nets = networkInterfaces();
        let localIp = '127.0.0.1';

        // Prioridad 1: LAN tÃ­pica (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x)
        for (const name of Object.keys(nets)) {
            for (const net of nets[name] || []) {
                if (net.family === 'IPv4' && !net.internal) {
                    if (net.address.startsWith('192.168.') || net.address.startsWith('10.')) {
                        localIp = net.address;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (localIp !== '127.0.0.1') break;
        }

        // Prioridad 2: Cualquier IPv4 no interna
        if (localIp === '127.0.0.1') {
            for (const name of Object.keys(nets)) {
                for (const net of nets[name] || []) {
                    if (net.family === 'IPv4' && !net.internal) {
                        localIp = net.address;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (localIp !== '127.0.0.1') break;
            }
        }

        return NextResponse.json({
            success: true,
            ip: localIp,
            publicUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || process.env.APP_URL || null
        });
    } catch {
        return NextResponse.json({ success: false, ip: '127.0.0.1' });
    }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { validateApiSession } from '@/lib/apiAuth';
import { sendMail } from '@/lib/mail';
import { auth, db } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
    const auth = validateApiSession(req);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;
    try {
        const body = await req.json();
        const { type, data, targetEmail, securityToken } = body;

        // VERIFICACIÃ“N DE SEGURIDAD BÃSICA
        // En producciÃ³n, esto deberÃ­a ser un secreto compartido o un JWT
        if (process.env.INTERNAL_API_SECRET && securityToken !== process.env.INTERNAL_API_SECRET) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No autorizado' }, { status: 401 });
        }

        let businessName = 'Nuestro Negocio';
        try {
            const siteConfigSnap = await db.collection('settings').doc('site_config').get();
            const siteConfigData = siteConfigSnap.data() as any;
            if (siteConfigSnap.exists && siteConfigData?.businessName) {
                businessName = siteConfigData.businessName;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Error leyendo configuraciÃ³n del negocio en API:", e);
        }

        let subject = '';
        let html = '';

        switch (type) {
            case 'ERROR_CRITICAL':
                subject = `ðŸš¨ ALERTA CRÃTICA: Error en Sistema`;
                html = `
                    <div style="font-family: sans-serif; border: 2px solid #E30613; padding: 20px; border-radius: 10px;">
                        <h2 style="color: #E30613;">Se ha detectado un error crÃ­tico</h2>
                        <p><b>DescripciÃ³n:</b> ${data.message}</p>
                        <p><b>Usuario:</b> ${data.userName} (${data.userId})</p>
                        <hr>
                        <p style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #666;">Enviado automÃ¡ticamente por el monitor de salud de ${businessName}.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                break;

            case 'INVOICE_SENT':
                subject = `ðŸ“„ Su Factura de ${businessName} - Orden #${data.orderId}`;
                html = `
                    <div style="font-family: sans-serif; padding: 20px;">
                        <h2>Gracias por su compra</h2>
                        <p>Adjunto encontrarÃ¡ su factura por su pedido reciente.</p>
                        <p><b>Orden:</b> #${data.orderId}</p>
                        <p><b>Total:</b> $${data.total} MXN</p>
                        <br>
                        <p><i>${businessName} - Agradece su preferencia.</i></p>
                    </div>
                `;
                break;

            case 'PANIC_ALERT':
                subject = `ðŸš¨ BOTÃ“N DE PÃNICO ACTIVADO - REPARTIDOR EN PELIGRO`;
                html = `
                    <div style="background-color: #E30613; color: white; padding: 30px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: sans-serif;">
                        <h1>Â¡EMERGENCIA DETECTADA!</h1>
                        <p>Un repartidor ha presionado el botÃ³n de pÃ¡nico.</p>
                        <p><b>Nombre:</b> ${data.driverName}</p>
                        <p><b>UbicaciÃ³n:</b> <a href="${data.mapsUrl}" style="color: yellow; font-weight: bold;">VER EN GOOGLE MAPS</a></p>
                        <p><b>Hora:</b> ${new Date().toLocaleString()}</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                break;

            default:
                subject = `NotificaciÃ³n de Sistema`;
                html = `<p>${JSON.stringify(data)}</p>`;
        }

        const result = await sendMail({
            to: targetEmail || process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || '',
            subject,
            html
        });

        // Registrar el envÃ­o en los logs de auditorÃ­a (opcional)
        if (result.success) {
            await db.collection('audit_logs').add({
                type: 'EMAIL_SENT',
                description: `Correo enviado: ${subject} a ${targetEmail}`,
                timestamp: new Date(),
                system: 'NOTIFICATION_SERVICE'
            });
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Error en Notification API:", error);
        return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

ARCHIVO: src\app\api\omnipulse\accounts\route.ts

/**
 * OMNIPULSE â€” API Routes de Accounts (SimulaciÃ³n Local)
 * GET  /api/omnipulse/accounts/list    â†’ Lista cuentas conectadas del tenant
 * POST /api/omnipulse/accounts/connect â†’ Conecta una nueva cuenta (token directo)
 * DELETE /api/omnipulse/accounts/[id] â†’ Desconecta una cuenta
 *
 * En producciÃ³n los tokens se guardan en SQLite con AES-256.
 * En esta versiÃ³n operamos con almacenamiento en memoria + localStorage en frontend.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type { NetworkId, OmniAccountSummary } from '@/lib/omnipulse/types';
import { accountStore } from '@/lib/omnipulse/store';

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
    const tenantId = request.headers.get('x-tenant-id') ?? 'default';
    const accounts = accountStore.get(tenantId) ?? [];
    return NextResponse.json({ accounts, count: accounts.length });
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
    try {
        const tenantId = request.headers.get('x-tenant-id') ?? 'default';
        const body = await request.json() as {
            network: NetworkId;
            accountName: string;
            accountId: string;
            accessToken: string;
            channelId?: string; // Para Telegram: ID del canal/chat
        };

        if (!body.network || !body.accountName || !body.accessToken) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Campos requeridos: network, accountName, accessToken' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        const newAccount: OmniAccountSummary = {
            id: `${body.network}_${Date.now()}`,
            network: body.network,
            accountName: body.accountName,
            accountId: body.accountId || body.channelId || body.accountName,
            isActive: true,
            isTokenValid: true,
            expiresAt: null,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        // Guardar token en contexto seguro (en prod â†’ Prisma + AES-256)
        // Por ahora almacÃ©n en memoria con referencia al token
        (newAccount as any)._token = body.accessToken;
        (newAccount as any)._channelId = body.channelId;

        const existing = accountStore.get(tenantId) ?? [];
        // Evitar duplicados por red+accountId
        const filtered = existing.filter(a => !(a.network === body.network && a.accountId === newAccount.accountId));
        accountStore.set(tenantId, [...filtered, newAccount]);

        return NextResponse.json({ account: newAccount, message: 'Cuenta conectada exitosamente' });
    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
    try {
        const tenantId = request.headers.get('x-tenant-id') ?? 'default';
        const { id } = await request.json();
        const existing = accountStore.get(tenantId) ?? [];
        accountStore.set(tenantId, existing.filter(a => a.id !== id));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

// Exportar el store para que el dispatcher pueda acceder a los tokens
export { accountStore };

/**
 * OMNIPULSE â€” Motor de Despacho con Jitter de HumanizaciÃ³n
 * POST /api/omnipulse/dispatch
 *
 * Recibe un postId y lista de accountIds, y los publica secuencialmente
 * en cada red social con un delay aleatorio entre publicaciones (jitter).
 * Actualiza el estado en tiempo real mediante Server-Sent Events.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { resolveSpintax } from '@/lib/omnipulse/spintax';
import type { NetworkId, DispatchResult, DispatchStatus } from '@/lib/omnipulse/types';
import { dispatchResults, postStore } from '@/lib/omnipulse/store';

const JITTER_MIN_MS = 4_000;
const JITTER_MAX_MS = 12_000;

function humanJitter(): number {
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (JITTER_MAX_MS - JITTER_MIN_MS + 1)) + JITTER_MIN_MS;
}

/**
 * Llama al adaptador correcto segÃºn la red social.
 * Cada adaptador encapsula la lÃ³gica de autenticaciÃ³n y publicaciÃ³n.
 */
async function publishToNetwork(
    network: NetworkId,
    text: string,
    mediaUrls: string[],
    token: string,
    channelId?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; externalId?: string; error?: string }> {

    const trimmedText = text.slice(0, getCharLimit(network));

    try {
        switch (network) {
            // â”€â”€â”€ GRUPO B: Token Directo â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            case 'telegram': {
                if (!channelId) return { success: false, error: 'Falta el ID del canal de Telegram' };
                const tgRes = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ chat_id: channelId, text: trimmedText, parse_mode: 'HTML' }),
                });
                const tgData = await tgRes.json();
                if (tgData.ok) return { success: true, externalId: String(tgData.result.message_id) };
                return { success: false, error: tgData.description };
            }

            case 'discord': {
                // token = Webhook URL completa de Discord
                const dcRes = await fetch(token, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ content: trimmedText }),
                });
                if (dcRes.ok) return { success: true, externalId: `discord_${Date.now()}` };
                const dcErr = await dcRes.text();
                return { success: false, error: dcErr };
            }

            // â”€â”€â”€ GRUPO C: Protocolos Abiertos â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            case 'bluesky': {
                // token = "handle:password" o "handle:app_password"
                const [identifier, password] = token.split(':');
                const authRes = await fetch('https://bsky.social/xrpc/com.atproto.server.createSession', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ identifier, password }),
                });
                if (!authRes.ok) return { success: false, error: 'Error de autenticaciÃ³n en Bluesky' };
                const { accessJwt, did } = await authRes.json();

                const postRes = await fetch('https://bsky.social/xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${accessJwt}` },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        repo: did,
                        collection: 'app.bsky.feed.post',
                        record: { text: trimmedText.slice(0, 300), createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), '$type': 'app.bsky.feed.post' },
                    }),
                });
                const bsData = await postRes.json();
                if (postRes.ok) return { success: true, externalId: bsData.uri };
                return { success: false, error: bsData.message };
            }

            case 'mastodon': {
                // token = "instance_url|access_token"  ej: "mastodon.social|abc123"
                const [instance, accessToken] = token.split('|');
                const mRes = await fetch(`https://${instance}/api/v1/statuses`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ status: trimmedText.slice(0, 500) }),
                });
                const mData = await mRes.json();
                if (mRes.ok) return { success: true, externalId: mData.id };
                return { success: false, error: mData.error };
            }

            // â”€â”€â”€ GRUPO A / C: SimulaciÃ³n (requieren App OAuth) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            case 'facebook':
            case 'instagram':
            case 'threads':
            case 'linkedin_personal':
            case 'linkedin_company':
            case 'youtube':
            case 'pinterest':
            case 'twitter':
            case 'tiktok':
            case 'reddit':
            case 'whatsapp':
            case 'tumblr': {
                // SIMULACIÃ“N: en producciÃ³n llaman a su respectiva API OAuth.
                // AquÃ­ retornamos Ã©xito simulado con el texto truncado.
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); // Simular latencia de red
                const fakeId = `${network}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
                return { success: true, externalId: fakeId };
            }

            default:
                return { success: false, error: `Red '${network}' no implementada aÃºn` };
        }
    } catch (err: any) {
        return { success: false, error: err.message ?? 'Error de red desconocido' };
    }
}

function getCharLimit(network: NetworkId): number {
    const limits: Record<NetworkId, number> = {
        facebook: 63206, instagram: 2200, threads: 500, linkedin_personal: 3000,
        linkedin_company: 3000, youtube: 5000, pinterest: 500, telegram: 4096,
        discord: 2000, whatsapp: 65536, twitter: 280, tiktok: 2200,
        bluesky: 300, mastodon: 500, reddit: 40000, tumblr: 4096,
    };
    return limits[network] ?? 2000;
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
    try {
        const body = await request.json() as {
            postId: string;
            postBody: string;
            hashtags?: string;
            mediaUrls?: string[];
            useSpintax?: boolean;
            accounts: Array<{
                id: string;
                network: NetworkId;
                accountName: string;
                token: string;
                channelId?: string;
            }>;
        };

        if (!body.postId || !body.postBody || !body.accounts?.length) {
            return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Faltan campos: postId, postBody, accounts' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        const results: DispatchResult[] = body.accounts.map(acc => ({
            accountId: acc.id,
            network: acc.network,
            accountName: acc.accountName,
            status: 'pending' as DispatchStatus,
        }));

        dispatchResults.set(body.postId, results);

        // Despacho asÃ­ncrono (no bloqueamos la respuesta HTTP)
        (async () => {
            for (let i = 0; i < body.accounts.length; i++) {
                const acc = body.accounts[i];

                // Actualizar estado a 'publishing'
                const current = dispatchResults.get(body.postId) ?? [];
                const idx = current.findIndex(r => r.accountId === acc.id);
                if (idx >= 0) current[idx].status = 'publishing';
                dispatchResults.set(body.postId, current);

                // Resolver Spintax si aplica
                const rawText = body.postBody + (body.hashtags ? `\n\n${body.hashtags}` : '');
                const finalText = body.useSpintax ? resolveSpintax(rawText) : rawText;

                // Publicar
                const result = await publishToNetwork(
                    acc.network, finalText, body.mediaUrls ?? [], acc.token, acc.channelId
                );

                // Actualizar resultado
                const updated = dispatchResults.get(body.postId) ?? [];
                const updIdx = updated.findIndex(r => r.accountId === acc.id);
                if (updIdx >= 0) {
                    updated[updIdx] = {
                        ...updated[updIdx],
                        status: result.success ? 'success' : 'failed',
                        externalId: result.externalId,
                        errorMsg: result.error,
                        publishedAt: result.success ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined,
                    };
                }
                dispatchResults.set(body.postId, updated);

                // Jitter de HumanizaciÃ³n entre publicaciones
                if (i < body.accounts.length - 1) {
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, humanJitter()));
                }
            }
        })();

        return NextResponse.json({
            postId: body.postId,
            message: `Despacho iniciado para ${body.accounts.length} cuentas`,
            status: 'dispatching',
        });

    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
import { jwtVerify } from 'jose';

import { validateApiSession, validateActiveDbUser } from '@/lib/apiAuth';
import bunkkerConfig from '../../../../bunkker.config.json';
const CUSTOMER_JWT_SECRET = new TextEncoder().encode(process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'super_secret_local_key');

async function writeOrderEvent(tx: any, event: {
    orderId: string;
    eventType: string;
    fromStatus?: string | null;
    toStatus?: string | null;
    actorId: string;
    actorName: string;
    actorRole: string;
    details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}) {
    return tx.orderEvent.create({
        data: {

            details: event.details ? JSON.stringify(event.details) : null
        }
    });
}

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';


export async function GET() {
    try {
        const now = new Date();
        const expiredOrders = await prisma.order.findMany({
            where: {
                expiresAt: { lte: now },
                confirmedAt: null,
                status: { in: ['pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'NIGHT_QUEUE', 'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA', 'PREPARANDO', 'READY_TO_SHIP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'] }
            },
            select: { id: true, status: true }
        });
        for (const expired of expiredOrders) {
            const cancelled = await prisma.order.updateMany({
                where: { id: expired.id, status: expired.status, confirmedAt: null },
                data: { status: 'cancelled', completedAt: now, rejectionReason: 'Reserva de pago vencida' }
            });
            if (cancelled.count === 1) {
                await prisma.orderEvent.create({
                    data: {
                        orderId: expired.id,
                        eventType: 'ORDER_EXPIRED',
                        fromStatus: expired.status,
                        toStatus: 'cancelled',
                        actorId: 'SYSTEM',
                        actorName: 'Sistema',
                        actorRole: 'system',
                        details: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'La reserva de stock venciÃ³ a las dos horas.' })
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
            include: { 
                items: { include: { product: true } }, 
                customer: true, 
                events: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } } 
            },
            orderBy: { date: 'desc' }
        });
        const data = orders.map((order) => ({
            ...order,
            items: order.items.map((it: any) => ({
                ...it,
                quantity: it.cantidad,
                price: it.precio,
                name: it.product?.name || 'Producto'
            })),
            deliveryMethod: order.deliveryType === 'DELIVERY'
                ? 'repartidor'
                : order.deliveryType === 'PATIO'
                    ? 'patio'
                    : order.deliveryType === 'PICKUP'
                        ? 'pickup'
                        : 'tienda',
            address: order.deliveryAddress || order.customer?.address || '',
            lat: order.deliveryLat,
            lng: order.deliveryLng
        }));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data });
    } catch (error: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
    try {
        // SEGURIDAD FAIL-CLOSED: Validar sesiÃ³n activa directamente en SQLite (no solo la firma HMAC)
        const staffSession = await validateActiveDbUser(request);
        let authenticatedCustomerId: string | null = null;
        let staffUser: { name: string } | null = null;

        if (staffSession.ok) {
            if (!['superadmin', 'admin', 'sales', 'billing', 'inventory'].includes(staffSession.role)) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'No tienes permiso para crear pedidos.' }, { status: 403 });
            }
            staffUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
                where: { id: staffSession.uid },
                select: { name: true }
            });
        } else {
            const customerToken = request.cookies.get('msj-session')?.value || request.cookies.get('admincom_session')?.value;
            if (!customerToken) return staffSession.response;

            try {
                const { payload } = await jwtVerify(customerToken, CUSTOMER_JWT_SECRET);
                if (payload.role !== 'customer' || typeof payload.uid !== 'string') {
                    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n con una cuenta de cliente.' }, { status: 401 });
                }
                authenticatedCustomerId = payload.uid;
            } catch {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'La sesiÃ³n de cliente venciÃ³. Inicia sesiÃ³n nuevamente.' }, { status: 401 });
            }
        }

        // AISLAMIENTO DE TENANT: Se deriva de la configuraciÃ³n soberana en base de datos, no de headers arbitrarios
        const appConfig = await prisma.appConfig.findUnique({ where: { id: 'global' } }).catch(() => null);
        const tenantId = appConfig?.tenantId || 'default';
        const body = await request.json();
        const orderId = body.orderId || body.id;
        const total = body.total;
        const clientData = body.clientData || body.customer || {};
        const items = body.items || [];
        const deliveryMethod = body.deliveryMethod || clientData.deliveryMethod;
        const deliveryType = body.deliveryType || (deliveryMethod === 'repartidor'
            ? 'DELIVERY'
            : deliveryMethod === 'patio' || deliveryMethod === 'PATIO'
                ? 'PATIO'
                : ['pickup', 'PICKUP', 'tienda'].includes(deliveryMethod)
                    ? 'PICKUP'
                    : 'LOCAL');
        const paymentMethod = body.paymentMethod;
        const isCashierRequest = Boolean(authenticatedCustomerId || body.asRequest);
        const location = clientData.gpsCoords || body.gpsCoords || {};
        const deliveryLat = body.deliveryLat ?? body.lat ?? clientData.lat ?? location.lat;
        const deliveryLng = body.deliveryLng ?? body.lng ?? clientData.lng ?? location.lng;

        if (!orderId || typeof total !== 'number' || !Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('Order ID, total y productos son obligatorios.');
        }

        // IDEMPOTENCIA EN BASE DE DATOS: Si la orden ya existe en SQLite (por reintento de red o reinicio del nodo),
        // responder inmediatamente con la orden existente para evitar descontar inventario doble.
        const existingOrder = await prisma.order.findUnique({
            where: { id: orderId },
            include: { items: true, customer: true }
        });
        if (existingOrder) {
            console.log(`[IDEMPOTENCIA DB] Orden ${orderId} ya procesada previamente en SQLite. Evitando duplicaciÃ³n.`);
            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: existingOrder, duplicated: true });
        }

        // staffUser ya fue cargado previamente para derivar tenantId
        const actorId = authenticatedCustomerId || (staffSession.ok ? staffSession.uid : 'SYSTEM');
        const actorName = authenticatedCustomerId ? (clientData.name || 'Cliente') : (staffUser?.name || 'Personal');
        const actorRole = authenticatedCustomerId ? 'customer' : (staffSession.ok ? staffSession.role : 'system');

        // Pending orders reserve availability; payment confirmation performs the stock deduction.
        const orderResult = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
            
            // 1. Resolver o Crear Cliente por TelÃ©fono (si existe clientData y tiene telÃ©fono)
            let customerId: string | null = authenticatedCustomerId;
            if (authenticatedCustomerId) {
                const registeredCustomer = await tx.customer.findUnique({ where: { id: authenticatedCustomerId } });
                if (!registeredCustomer) throw new Error('No se encontrÃ³ la cuenta de cliente asociada a la sesiÃ³n.');

                if (deliveryType === 'DELIVERY' && clientData.address) {
                    await tx.customer.update({
                        where: { id: authenticatedCustomerId },
                        data: {
                            address: clientData.address,
                            references: clientData.references || undefined,
                            gpsCoords: deliveryLat != null && deliveryLng != null ? `${deliveryLat},${deliveryLng}` : undefined
                        }
                    });
                }
            } else if (clientData && clientData.phone) {
                let customer = await tx.customer.findUnique({
                    where: { phone: clientData.phone }
                });

                if (!customer) {
                    customer = await tx.customer.create({
                        data: {
                            tenantId,
                            name: clientData.name || 'Cliente GenÃ©rico',
                            phone: clientData.phone,
                            address: clientData.address || null,
                            references: clientData.references || null,
                            gpsCoords: deliveryLat != null && deliveryLng != null
                                ? `${deliveryLat},${deliveryLng}`
                                : null
                        }
                    });
                } else if (deliveryType === 'DELIVERY' && clientData.address) {
                    // Actualizar datos de entrega si regresÃ³ con nueva direcciÃ³n
                    customer = await tx.customer.update({
                        where: { id: customer.id },
                        data: {
                            address: clientData.address,
                            references: clientData.references,
                            gpsCoords: deliveryLat != null && deliveryLng != null
                                ? `${deliveryLat},${deliveryLng}`
                                : undefined
                        }
                    });
                }
                customerId = customer.id;
            }

            // 2. Descuento en Caliente de Inventario Local con ValidaciÃ³n AtÃ³mica (Evita Race Conditions)
            // FIX BUG-1: Leer stock ANTES de decrementar para evitar stock negativo.
            // Prisma ejecuta cada update de forma secuencial dentro de la transacciÃ³n,
            // pero no bloquea el registro entre la lectura y la escritura a nivel SQL.
            // La soluciÃ³n correcta es: leer â†’ validar â†’ decrementar condicionalmente.
            for (const item of items) {
                // Paso A: Verificar stock actual antes de modificar
                const current = await tx.product.findUnique({
                    where: { id: item.productId },
                    select: { stock: true, reservedStock: true, id: true }
                });

                if (!current) {
                    throw new Error(`Producto no encontrado: (ID: ${item.productId}).`);
                }

                const availableStock = current.stock - current.reservedStock;
                if (availableStock < item.quantity) {
                    throw new Error(`Inventario insuficiente para el producto (ID: ${item.productId}). Disponible: ${availableStock}, solicitado: ${item.quantity}.`);
                }

                if (!isCashierRequest) {
                    await tx.product.update({
                        where: { id: item.productId },
                        data: { stock: { decrement: item.quantity } }
                    });
                }
            }

                    const initialStatus = isCashierRequest
                        ? authenticatedCustomerId ? 'pending_payment' : body.status || 'pending_payment'
                        : body.status || 'paid';

                    const isPending = ['pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation'].includes(initialStatus);

                    // 3. CreaciÃ³n de la Orden en el Pipeline LogÃ­stico
                    const order = await tx.order.create({
                        data: {
                            id: orderId,
                            tenantId,
                            total,
                            deliveryType: deliveryType || (deliveryMethod === 'repartidor' ? 'DELIVERY' : (deliveryMethod === 'pickup' ? 'PICKUP' : 'LOCAL')),
                            paymentMethod: isCashierRequest ? 'pago_caja' : paymentMethod || 'CASH',
                            status: initialStatus,
                            vendedorId: isCashierRequest ? null : body.vendedorId || null,
                            vendedorName: isCashierRequest ? null : body.vendedorName || null,
                            confirmedAt: isCashierRequest ? null : body.confirmedAt ? new Date(body.confirmedAt) : new Date(),
                            expiresAt: body.expiresAt ? new Date(body.expiresAt) : isPending ? new Date(Date.now() + bunkkerConfig.reservation.timeoutMs) : null,
                    deliveryPin: body.deliveryPin || null,
                    deliveryLat: typeof deliveryLat === 'number' ? deliveryLat : null,
                    deliveryLng: typeof deliveryLng === 'number' ? deliveryLng : null,
                    deliveryAddress: clientData?.address || null,
                    customerId: customerId,
                    items: {
                        create: items.map((item: any) => ({
                            productId: item.productId || item.id,
                            cantidad: item.quantity ?? item.cantidad,
                            precio: item.price ?? item.precio
                        }))
                    }
                },
                include: { customer: true, items: true }
            });

            await tx.orderEvent.create({
                data: {
                    orderId,
                    eventType: 'ORDER_CREATED',
                    toStatus: order.status,
                    actorId,
                    actorName,
                    actorRole,
                    details: JSON.stringify({ deliveryType, itemCount: items.length, total })
                }
            });
            return order;
        }, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' });

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: orderResult });

    } catch (error: any) {
        const bodyJson = await request.clone().json().catch(() => ({}));
        const collisionId = bodyJson.orderId || bodyJson.id;

        // 1. COLISIÃ“N DE PRIMARY KEY (P2002 / Unique constraint):
        // Verificar estrictamente si la colisiÃ³n ocurriÃ³ sobre el identificador de la orden (Order.id).
        const isOrderPkCollision = error.code === 'P2002' || (
            typeof error.message === 'string' &&
            error.message.includes('Unique constraint failed') &&
            (!error.meta?.target || (Array.isArray(error.meta.target) && error.meta.target.includes('id')))
        );

        if (isOrderPkCollision && collisionId) {
            try {
                const existing = await prisma.order.findUnique({
                    where: { id: collisionId },
                    include: { items: true, customer: true }
                });
                if (existing) {
                    console.log(`[IDEMPOTENCIA P2002] Orden ${collisionId} ya existÃ­a en BD. Retornando 200 idempotente.`);
                    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: existing, duplicated: true });
                }
            } catch (pkLookupError) {
                console.error('[IDEMPOTENCY] Error al buscar orden tras colisiÃ³n P2002:', pkLookupError);
            }
        }

        // 2. CONFLICTO DE SERIALIZACIÃ“N / BLOQUEO TRANSITORIO (P2034 / SQLITE_BUSY):
        const isBusyOrLockConflict = error.code === 'P2034' || 
            (typeof error.message === 'string' && (
                error.message.includes('SQLITE_BUSY') || 
                error.message.includes('database is locked') ||
                error.message.includes('Transaction failed due to a write conflict')
            ));

        if (isBusyOrLockConflict) {
            if (collisionId) {
                // Verificar si otra transacciÃ³n paralela que ganÃ³ el lock ya completÃ³ la orden
                const existing = await prisma.order.findUnique({
                    where: { id: collisionId },
                    include: { items: true, customer: true }
                }).catch(() => null);

                if (existing) {
                    console.log(`[CONCURRENCY RACE HANDLED] Orden ${collisionId} fue completada por transacciÃ³n paralela. Retornando 200 idempotente.`);
                    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: existing, duplicated: true });
                }
            }

            // Si la orden NO existe, fue una contenciÃ³n real de concurrencia: retornar 409 reintentable
            console.warn(`[CONCURRENCY CONTENTION] Bloqueo transitorio en SQLite (P2034/SQLITE_BUSY). Orden ${collisionId} no creada.`);
            return NextResponse.json({
                success: false,
                error: 'Conflicto de concurrencia en base de datos. Por favor reintente la operaciÃ³n.',
                retryable: true
            }, { status: 409 });
        }

        console.error(`[ACID Transaction Error]: ${error.message}`);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}


export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
    const auth = await validateActiveDbUser(request);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

    try {
        const body = await request.json();
        const { id, action, ...updates } = body;
        if (!id) throw new Error('Order ID is required');

        const actorUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: auth.uid }, select: { name: true } });
        const actorName = actorUser?.name || auth.uid;
        const actorRole = auth.role;
        const cashierRoles = ['sales', 'billing', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
        const loadingRoles = ['carga_descarga', 'inventory', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
        const deliveryRoles = ['driver', 'carga_descarga', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
        const cashierReadyStatuses = ['READY_TO_SHIP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'pending', 'NIGHT_QUEUE'];

        if (action === 'claim_cashier') {
            if (!cashierRoles.includes(actorRole)) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para tomar cobros.' }, { status: 403 });
            const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                const current = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
                if (!current || !cashierReadyStatuses.includes(current.status)) return { conflict: true };
                if (current.vendedorId === auth.uid) return { order: current, alreadyClaimed: true };
                if (current.vendedorId) return { conflict: true, claimedBy: current.vendedorName };

                const claimed = await tx.order.updateMany({
                    where: { id, status: current.status, vendedorId: null },
                    data: { vendedorId: auth.uid, vendedorName: actorName }
                });
                if (claimed.count !== 1) return { conflict: true };

                const order = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
                await writeOrderEvent(tx, { orderId: id, eventType: 'CASHIER_CLAIMED', fromStatus: current.status, toStatus: current.status, actorId: auth.uid, actorName, actorRole });
                return { order };
            });
            if (result.conflict) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: result.claimedBy ? `Pedido tomado por ${result.claimedBy}.` : 'Otro cajero tomÃ³ este pedido o ya cambiÃ³ de etapa.' }, { status: 409 });
            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: result.order });
        }

        if (action === 'cashier_payment') {
            if (!cashierRoles.includes(actorRole)) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para confirmar cobros.' }, { status: 403 });
            try {
                const order = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                    const current = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { items: true } });
                    if (!current || !cashierReadyStatuses.includes(current.status) || current.confirmedAt || (current.vendedorId && current.vendedorId !== auth.uid) || (current.expiresAt && current.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now())) {
                        throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:El pedido no estÃ¡ listo, ya fue pagado o pertenece a otro cajero.');
                    }

                    // FLOTACIÃ“N ESTRICTA: En caja se asegura la existencia y se aparta en reservedStock.
                    // El 'stock' fÃ­sico en anaquel NO se decrementa definitivamente hasta que se valida la entrega con comprobante/firma.
                    for (const item of current.items) {
                        const product = await tx.product.findUnique({ where: { id: item.productId }, select: { stock: true, reservedStock: true } });
                        if (!product || (product.stock - product.reservedStock) < item.cantidad) {
                            throw new Error(`ORDER_CONFLICT:Inventario insuficiente para ${item.productId}.`);
                        }
                        await tx.product.update({ 
                            where: { id: item.productId }, 
                            data: { reservedStock: { increment: item.cantidad } } 
                        });
                    }

                    const isPickup = ['PICKUP', 'PATIO'].includes(current.deliveryType);
                    const isDelivery = current.deliveryType === 'DELIVERY';
                    const nextStatus = current.isLoaded
                        ? isDelivery ? 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' : isPickup ? 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID' : 'COMPLETED'
                        : 'paid';
                    const updated = await tx.order.updateMany({
                        where: {
                            id,
                            status: current.status,
                            confirmedAt: null,
                            OR: [
                                { vendedorId: auth.uid },
                                { vendedorId: null }
                            ]
                        },
                        data: {
                            status: nextStatus,
                            paymentMethod: updates.paymentMethod || 'cash',
                            confirmedAt: new Date(),
                            vendedorId: auth.uid,
                            vendedorName: actorName,
                            ...(updates.ventanilla ? { ventanilla: updates.ventanilla } : {}),
                            ...(updates.cajon ? { cajon: updates.cajon } : {})
                        }
                    });
                    if (updated.count !== 1) throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:Otro cajero confirmÃ³ este pago.');

                    await writeOrderEvent(tx, {
                        orderId: id,
                        eventType: 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED',
                        fromStatus: current.status,
                        toStatus: nextStatus,
                        actorId: auth.uid,
                        actorName,
                        actorRole,
                        details: { paymentMethod: updates.paymentMethod || 'cash', total: current.total }
                    });
                    return tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { customer: true, items: true } });
                }, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' });
                return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: order });
            } catch (error: any) {
                if (String(error.message).startsWith('ORDER_CONFLICT:')) {
                    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: String(error.message).replace('ORDER_CONFLICT:', '') }, { status: 409 });
                }
                throw error;
            }
        }

        if (action === 'claim_loading') {
            if (!loadingRoles.includes(actorRole)) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para preparar pedidos.' }, { status: 403 });
            const current = await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
            const loadingStatuses = ['pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'paid', 'PREPARANDO', 'NIGHT_QUEUE', 'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA'];
            if (!current || !loadingStatuses.includes(current.status) || current.isLoaded) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'El pedido ya no estÃ¡ disponible para almacÃ©n.' }, { status: 409 });
            }
            const claimed = await prisma.order.updateMany({
                where: { id, status: current.status, isLoaded: false, loadedByUid: null },
                data: { loadedBy: actorName, loadedByUid: auth.uid, loadingStartedAt: new Date() }
            });
            if (claimed.count !== 1) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Otro almacenista tomÃ³ este pedido.' }, { status: 409 });
            await prisma.orderEvent.create({ data: { orderId: id, eventType: 'LOADING_CLAIMED', fromStatus: current.status, toStatus: current.status, actorId: auth.uid, actorName, actorRole } });
            const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: order });
        }

        if (action === 'complete_loading') {
            if (!loadingRoles.includes(actorRole)) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para finalizar la preparaciÃ³n.' }, { status: 403 });
            const current = await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
            if (!current || current.isLoaded || (current.loadedByUid !== auth.uid && actorRole !== 'superadmin' && actorRole !== 'admin')) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'El pedido no estÃ¡ asignado a este almacenista.' }, { status: 409 });
            }
            const isPickup = ['PICKUP', 'PATIO'].includes(current.deliveryType);
            const isDelivery = current.deliveryType === 'DELIVERY';
            const isPaid = Boolean(current.confirmedAt) || current.status === 'paid';
            const nextStatus = isPickup
                ? isPaid ? 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID' : 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'
                : isDelivery
                    ? isPaid ? 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' : 'READY_TO_SHIP'
                    : 'COMPLETED';
            const updated = await prisma.order.updateMany({
                where: { id, status: current.status, isLoaded: false, loadedByUid: current.loadedByUid },
                data: { isLoaded: true, loadingFinishedAt: new Date(), status: nextStatus }
            });
            if (updated.count !== 1) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'El pedido cambiÃ³ de estado; actualiza la lista.' }, { status: 409 });
            await prisma.orderEvent.create({ data: { orderId: id, eventType: 'LOADING_COMPLETED', fromStatus: current.status, toStatus: nextStatus, actorId: auth.uid, actorName, actorRole } });
            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id } }) });
        }

        if (action === 'claim_delivery') {
            if (!deliveryRoles.includes(actorRole)) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para tomar rutas.' }, { status: 403 });
            const claimed = await prisma.order.updateMany({
                where: { id, status: 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', assignedDriverId: null },
                data: { status: 'claimed', assignedDriverId: auth.uid }
            });
            if (claimed.count !== 1) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Otro repartidor tomÃ³ este pedido o aÃºn no estÃ¡ liberado a ruta.' }, { status: 409 });
            await prisma.orderEvent.create({ data: { orderId: id, eventType: 'DRIVER_CLAIMED', fromStatus: 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', toStatus: 'claimed', actorId: auth.uid, actorName, actorRole } });
            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id } }) });
        }

        if (action === 'confirm_pickup_receipt') {
            if (!['pickup', 'inventory', 'carga_descarga', 'driver', 'admin', 'superadmin'].includes(actorRole)) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para entregar pedidos pickup.' }, { status: 403 });
            }
            const order = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                const current = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { items: true } });
                if (!current || !['READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'].includes(current.status) || !current.confirmedAt) {
                    throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:El pedido debe estar preparado y pagado antes de entregarlo.');
                }

                // DEDUCCIÃ“N FINAL AL VALIDAR ENTREGA EN TIENDA / PATIO:
                // Se descuenta fÃ­sicamente de 'stock' y se limpia la reserva 'reservedStock'.
                for (const item of current.items) {
                    await tx.product.update({
                        where: { id: item.productId },
                        data: {
                            stock: { decrement: item.cantidad },
                            reservedStock: { decrement: item.cantidad }
                        }
                    });
                }

                const updated = await tx.order.updateMany({
                    where: { id, status: current.status, confirmedAt: { not: null } },
                    data: { status: 'DELIVERED', completedAt: new Date() }
                });
                if (updated.count !== 1) throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:El pedido ya fue cerrado por otro operador.');

                await writeOrderEvent(tx, { orderId: id, eventType: 'PICKUP_RECEIVED', fromStatus: current.status, toStatus: 'DELIVERED', actorId: auth.uid, actorName, actorRole });
                return tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
            }, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' });

            return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: order });
        }

        if (updates.driverId !== undefined) {
            updates.assignedDriverId = updates.driverId;
        }

        const allowedFields = [
            'tenantId', 'total', 'paymentMethod', 'status', 'deliveryType', 
            'date', 'offline', 'synced', 'ventanilla', 'cajon', 
            'vendedorId', 'vendedorName', 'confirmedAt', 'customerId',
            'deliveryPin', 'deliveryLat', 'deliveryLng', 'deliveryAddress',
            'loadedBy', 'loadedByUid', 'loadingStartedAt', 'loadingFinishedAt',
            'isLoaded', 'assignedDriverId', 'signatureData', 'photoData',
            'completedAt', 'rejectionReason', 'expiresAt'
        ];
        const prismaUpdates: any = {};
        for (const key of allowedFields) {
            if (updates[key] !== undefined) {
                prismaUpdates[key] = ['date', 'confirmedAt', 'loadingStartedAt', 'loadingFinishedAt', 'completedAt', 'expiresAt'].includes(key)
                    && typeof updates[key] === 'string'
                    ? new Date(updates[key])
                    : updates[key];
            }
        }
        
        const current = await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { items: true } });
        if (!current) return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Pedido no encontrado.' }, { status: 404 });

        if (['DELIVERED', 'rejected', 'no_answer'].includes(updates.status)) {
            if (actorRole !== 'superadmin' && current.assignedDriverId !== auth.uid && !['carga_descarga', 'inventory'].includes(actorRole)) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Este pedido pertenece a otro repartidor u operador.' }, { status: 403 });
            }
            if (updates.status === 'DELIVERED' && (!updates.signatureData || !updates.photoData)) {
                return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Se requiere foto y firma para cerrar la entrega.' }, { status: 400 });
            }
        }

        let order;
        if (updates.status === 'cancelled') {
            order = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                const changed = await tx.order.updateMany({
                    where: { id, status: current.status },
                    data: prismaUpdates
                });
                if (changed.count !== 1) throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:El pedido cambiÃ³ mientras se cancelaba.');

                // CANCELACIÃ“N INTELIGENTE:
                // Si la venta ya habÃ­a descontado el stock fÃ­sico directamente (venta local COMPLETED / delivery DELIVERED):
                // -> Incrementamos 'stock' fÃ­sico para regresarlo a anaquel.
                // Si la orden estaba en proceso (preventa / picking / ruta) y tenÃ­a el stock en 'reservedStock':
                // -> Decrementamos 'reservedStock' para liberar el apartado sin tocar stock fÃ­sico.
                if (current.confirmedAt) {
                    const wasPhysicalStockDeducted = current.status === 'DELIVERED' || current.status === 'COMPLETED' || current.deliveryType === 'LOCAL';
                    for (const item of current.items) {
                        if (wasPhysicalStockDeducted) {
                            await tx.product.update({
                                where: { id: item.productId },
                                data: { stock: { increment: item.cantidad } }
                            });
                        } else {
                            await tx.product.update({ 
                                where: { id: item.productId }, 
                                data: { reservedStock: { decrement: item.cantidad } } 
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                const updated = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
                await writeOrderEvent(tx, {
                    orderId: id,
                    eventType: 'ORDER_CANCELLED',
                    fromStatus: current.status,
                    toStatus: 'cancelled',
                    actorId: auth.uid,
                    actorName,
                    actorRole,
                    details: { stockRestored: Boolean(current.confirmedAt) }
                });
                return updated;
            }, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' });
        } else {
            order = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                const changed = await tx.order.updateMany({
                    where: { id, status: current.status },
                    data: prismaUpdates
                });
                if (changed.count !== 1) throw new Error('ORDER_CONFLICT:El pedido cambiÃ³ mientras se actualizaba.');

                // DEDUCCIÃ“N FINAL AL VALIDAR ENTREGA CON COMPROBANTE/FIRMA (DELIVERED):
                if (updates.status === 'DELIVERED' && current.status !== 'DELIVERED') {
                    for (const item of current.items) {
                        await tx.product.update({
                            where: { id: item.productId },
                            data: {
                                stock: { decrement: item.cantidad },
                                reservedStock: { decrement: item.cantidad }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

                const updated = await tx.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
                if (updates.status !== undefined || updates.signatureData || updates.photoData || updates.rejectionReason) {
                    await writeOrderEvent(tx, {
                        orderId: id,
                        eventType: updates.status === 'DELIVERED' ? 'DELIVERY_RECEIVED' : updates.status ? `STATUS_${String(updates.status).toUpperCase()}` : 'ORDER_EVIDENCE_ADDED',
                        fromStatus: current.status,
                        toStatus: updates.status || current.status,
                        actorId: auth.uid,
                        actorName,
                        actorRole,
                        details: {
                            photoAttached: Boolean(updates.photoData),
                            signatureAttached: Boolean(updates.signatureData),
                            rejectionReason: updates.rejectionReason || null
                        }
                    });
                }
                return updated;
            }, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' });
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: order });
    } catch (error: any) {
        if (String(error.message).startsWith('ORDER_CONFLICT:')) {
            return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: String(error.message).replace('ORDER_CONFLICT:', '') }, { status: 409 });
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
    const auth = await validateActiveDbUser(request);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

    try {
        const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
        let id = searchParams.get('id');
        if (!id) {
            const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
            id = body.id;
        }

        if (!id) {
            return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'ID de orden requerido.' }, { status: 400 });
        }

        const cashierRoles = ['sales', 'billing', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
        if (!cashierRoles.includes(auth.role)) {
            return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Rol sin permiso para eliminar pedidos.' }, { status: 403 });
        }

        const current = await prisma.order.findUnique({
            where: { id },
            include: { items: true }
        });

        if (!current) {
            return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Pedido no encontrado.' }, { status: 404 });
        }

        // Si tenÃ­a stock descontado o apartado y no estaba cancelado, restaurar:
        if (current.confirmedAt && current.status !== 'cancelled') {
            const wasPhysicalStockDeducted = current.status === 'DELIVERED' || current.status === 'COMPLETED' || current.deliveryType === 'LOCAL';
            for (const item of current.items) {
                if (wasPhysicalStockDeducted) {
                    await prisma.product.update({
                        where: { id: item.productId },
                        data: { stock: { increment: item.cantidad } }
                    }).catch(() => {});
                } else {
                    await prisma.product.update({
                        where: { id: item.productId },
                        data: { reservedStock: { decrement: item.cantidad } }
                    }).catch(() => {});
                }
            }
        }

        await prisma.order.delete({
            where: { id }
        });

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Pedido eliminado correctamente.' });
    } catch (error: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const config = await prisma.appConfig.findUnique({
      where: { id: 'global' },
    });

    if (!config) {
      return NextResponse.json({ isPro: false });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      isPro: config.licenseType === 'PRO',
      tenantId: config.tenantId,
      cloudToken: config.cloudToken,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Database error' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { serial } = await req.json();

    if (!serial || serial.length !== 6) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Serial invÃ¡lido' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // El .exe toca la puerta de la Nube (Firebase Cloud Function)
    const CLOUD_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUD_URL || 'https://us-central1-admin-erp-pro-1.cloudfunctions.net';
    
    console.log(`[PAIRING] Solicitando acceso VIP a la nube con PIN: ${serial}`);

    const response = await fetch(`${CLOUD_URL}/pairDesktopNode`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ pin: serial }),
    });

    const cloudData = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok || !cloudData.success) {
      console.error('[PAIRING] Rechazado por la Nube:', cloudData.error);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: cloudData.error || 'Fallo al emparejar con la nube' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // La Nube nos aceptÃ³, guardamos el Certificado de Matrimonio en el cerebro local (SQLite)
    await prisma.appConfig.upsert({
      where: { id: 'global' },
      update: {
        licenseType: 'PRO',
        tenantId: cloudData.tenantId,
        cloudToken: cloudData.token, // Token para autenticar futuros envÃ­os de datos
        pairedAt: new Date(),
      },
      create: {
        id: 'global',
        licenseType: 'PRO',
        tenantId: cloudData.tenantId,
        cloudToken: cloudData.token,
        pairedAt: new Date(),
      }
    });

    console.log(`[PAIRING] Â¡Ã‰xito! .exe vinculado permanentemente al Inquilino: ${cloudData.tenantId}`);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      tenantId: cloudData.tenantId,
      message: 'Sistema PRO Activado. Eres VIP.'
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[PAIRING] Error Interno:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Error de red o de sistema' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
