/**
 * Helper para detectar el Tenant ID (Cliente) en el Frontend (Client Components).
 * Extrae el subdominio de window.location.hostname.
 */

const PUBLIC_DOMAINS = [
    'admin.com', 
    'localhost', 
    '127.0.0.1', 
    'www.admin.com', 
    'admin-com-erp.vercel.app'
];

export function getTenantId(): string {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        return 'default'; // SSR fallback
    }

    const hostname = window.location.hostname;

    // Si es localhost o el dominio raÃ­z, usamos el default (tu ERP principal local)
    if (PUBLIC_DOMAINS.includes(hostname)) {
        return 'default';
    }

    // ExpresiÃ³n regular para detectar si es una direcciÃ³n IP (IPv4) y evitar asignaciÃ³n errÃ³nea en LAN
    const isIP = /^(?:[0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$/.test(hostname);
    if (isIP) {
        return 'default';
    }

    // Ejemplo: ferreteriasol.admin.com -> ["ferreteriasol", "admin", "com"] -> "ferreteriasol"
    const parts = hostname.split('.');
    if (parts.length >= 3) {
        return parts[0];
    }

    return 'default';
}

/**
 * Genera la ruta base para Firestore dependiendo del Tenant.
 * Si es el default, sigue usando la raÃ­z para no romper el cÃ³digo actual.
 * Si es un cliente nuevo, usarÃ¡ tenants/nombre_cliente/
 */
export function getTenantBasePath(tenantId: string = getTenantId()): string {
    if (tenantId === 'default') {
        return ''; // El ERP local y tu sistema base guardan en la raÃ­z
    }
    return `tenants/${tenantId}/`;
}

// src/lib/thermalPrinter.ts
export interface PrintData {
    businessName: string;
    orderId: string;
    items: { name: string; quantity: number; price: number }[];
    total: number;
    date: Date;
    customerName?: string;
}

const formatCurrency = (val: number) => `$${val.toFixed(2)}`;

// ESC/POS Commands
const CMD = {
    INIT: new Uint8Array([0x1B, 0x40]),
    ALIGN_CENTER: new Uint8Array([0x1B, 0x61, 0x01]),
    ALIGN_LEFT: new Uint8Array([0x1B, 0x61, 0x00]),
    BOLD_ON: new Uint8Array([0x1B, 0x45, 0x01]),
    BOLD_OFF: new Uint8Array([0x1B, 0x45, 0x00]),
    CUT: new Uint8Array([0x1D, 0x56, 0x41, 0x10]),
    FEED: new Uint8Array([0x0A])
};

const encodeText = (text: string) => {
    return new TextEncoder().encode(text + '\n');
};

export const printReceiptWithWebSerial = async (data: PrintData) => {
    if (!('serial' in navigator)) {
        throw new Error('La API Web Serial no estÃ¡ soportada en tu navegador actual. Usa Chrome, Edge, o Opera en PC/Android.');
    }

    try {
        // Pedir al usuario seleccionar el puerto USB/Serial de la impresora
        // @ts-ignore - Web Serial API navigator.serial is not in standard DOM typings
        const port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
        await port.open({ baudRate: 9600 }); // Impresoras tÃ©rmicas comunes usan 9600 o 115200

        const writer = port.writable.getWriter();

        // Inicializar
        await writer.write(CMD.INIT);
        
        // Cabecera (Centrado)
        await writer.write(CMD.ALIGN_CENTER);
        await writer.write(CMD.BOLD_ON);
        await writer.write(encodeText(data.businessName || 'MI TIENDA'));
        await writer.write(CMD.BOLD_OFF);
        await writer.write(encodeText('--------------------------------'));
        await writer.write(encodeText(`TICKET: ${data.orderId}`));
        await writer.write(encodeText(`FECHA: ${data.date.toLocaleDateString()} ${data.date.toLocaleTimeString()}`));
        if (data.customerName) {
            await writer.write(encodeText(`CLIENTE: ${data.customerName}`));
        }
        await writer.write(encodeText('--------------------------------'));
        
        // Cuerpo de Ticket (Izquierda)
        await writer.write(CMD.ALIGN_LEFT);
        await writer.write(encodeText('CANT  DESCRIPCION      TOTAL'));
        
        for (const item of data.items) {
            // Formatear lÃ­nea (simple padding de espacios)
            const qtyStr = String(item.quantity).padEnd(4, ' ');
            const nameStr = item.name.substring(0, 14).padEnd(15, ' ');
            const totalStr = formatCurrency(item.quantity * item.price).padStart(8, ' ');
            
            await writer.write(encodeText(`${qtyStr} ${nameStr} ${totalStr}`));
        }
        
        await writer.write(CMD.ALIGN_CENTER);
        await writer.write(encodeText('--------------------------------'));
        await writer.write(CMD.BOLD_ON);
        await writer.write(encodeText(`TOTAL VENTA: ${formatCurrency(data.total)}`));
        await writer.write(CMD.BOLD_OFF);
        await writer.write(encodeText('--------------------------------'));
        
        await writer.write(encodeText('Gracias por su preferencia.'));
        await writer.write(CMD.FEED);
        await writer.write(CMD.FEED);
        await writer.write(CMD.FEED);
        await writer.write(CMD.CUT); // Cortar papel
        
        await writer.releaseLock();
        await port.close();

        return true;
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('Error al imprimir por Web Serial:', err);
        throw err;
    }
};

/**
 * toast.ts â€” Sistema de notificaciones global
 * Funciona desde contextos, componentes, y funciones utilitarias.
 * Usa window.dispatchEvent para no requerir hooks ni providers.
 */

export type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface ToastPayload {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  type: ToastType;
  duration?: number; // ms â€” default: 4000
  title?: string;
}

const TOAST_EVENT = 'erp:toast';

function emit(payload: Omit<ToastPayload, 'id'>) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  const event = new CustomEvent<ToastPayload>(TOAST_EVENT, {
    detail: { ...payload, id: `toast-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}` },
  });
  window.dispatchEvent(event);
}

export const toast = {
  success: (message: string, title?: string, duration?: number) =>
    emit({ type: 'success', message, title, duration }),
  error: (message: string, title?: string, duration?: number) =>
    emit({ type: 'error', message, title, duration: duration ?? 6000 }),
  warning: (message: string, title?: string, duration?: number) =>
    emit({ type: 'warning', message, title, duration }),
  info: (message: string, title?: string, duration?: number) =>
    emit({ type: 'info', message, title, duration }),
};

export const TOAST_EVENT_KEY = TOAST_EVENT;

/**
 * Motor de Enrutamiento Inteligente Offline (TSP)
 * Calcula la distancia utilizando la fÃ³rmula Haversine (lÃ­nea recta sobre la esfera terrestre).
 * Optimiza la ruta utilizando Vecino MÃ¡s Cercano (Nearest Neighbor) + OptimizaciÃ³n 2-Opt.
 */

interface Point {
    id: string;
    lat: number;
    lng: number;
}

// Distancia en metros entre dos coordenadas (Haversine)
function getDistance(p1: Point, p2: Point): number {
    const R = 6371e3; // Radio de la Tierra en metros
    const dLat = (p2.lat - p1.lat) * (Math.PI / 180);
    const dLon = (p2.lng - p1.lng) * (Math.PI / 180);
    const a = 
        Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
        Math.cos(p1.lat * (Math.PI / 180)) * Math.cos(p2.lat * (Math.PI / 180)) * 
        Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
    const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
    return R * c;
}

// Calcula la distancia total de una ruta
function calculateTotalDistance(route: Point[]): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < route.length - 1; i++) {
        total += getDistance(route[i], route[i + 1]);
    }
    return total;
}

/**
 * Optimiza la ruta de entrega partiendo y regresando a la bodega.
 * @param warehouse UbicaciÃ³n de la bodega
 * @param deliveries Lista de puntos de entrega
 * @returns Array de Ã­ndices originales optimizados
 */
export function optimizeRoute(warehouse: Omit<Point, 'id'>, deliveries: Point[]): number[] {
    if (deliveries.length === 0) return [];
    if (deliveries.length === 1) return [0];

    const start: Point = { id: 'WH', lat: warehouse.lat, lng: warehouse.lng };
    
    // 1. Fase de ConstrucciÃ³n: Vecino mÃ¡s cercano (Greedy)
    let unvisited = deliveries.map((d, index) => ({ ...d, originalIndex: index }));
    let current = start;
    let route = [];
    
    while (unvisited.length > 0) {
        let nearestIdx = 0;
        let minDistance = Infinity;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < unvisited.length; i++) {
            const dist = getDistance(current, unvisited[i]);
            if (dist < minDistance) {
                minDistance = dist;
                nearestIdx = i;
            }
        }
        
        const nextPoint = unvisited[nearestIdx];
        route.push(nextPoint);
        current = nextPoint;
        unvisited.splice(nearestIdx, 1);
    }
    
    // 2. Fase de Mejora: Algoritmo 2-Opt (Deshace cruces de lÃ­neas)
    let improved = true;
    let bestRoute = [start, ...route, start]; // Ruta completa incluyendo regreso a bodega
    
    while (improved) {
        improved = false;
        for (let i = 1; i < bestRoute.length - 2; i++) {
            for (let k = i + 1; k < bestRoute.length - 1; k++) {
                const p1 = bestRoute[i - 1];
                const p2 = bestRoute[i];
                const p3 = bestRoute[k];
                const p4 = bestRoute[k + 1];

                const currentDist = getDistance(p1, p2) + getDistance(p3, p4);
                const newDist = getDistance(p1, p3) + getDistance(p2, p4);

                if (newDist < currentDist) {
                    // Reversa el segmento entre i y k
                    const reversedSegment = bestRoute.slice(i, k + 1).reverse();
                    bestRoute.splice(i, k - i + 1, ...reversedSegment);
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Extraer solo los Ã­ndices de las entregas (sin la bodega)
    const optimizedIndices: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < bestRoute.length - 1; i++) {
        const point = bestRoute[i] as any; // any para acceder a originalIndex
        optimizedIndices.push(point.originalIndex);
    }

    return optimizedIndices;
}

/**
 * Script de ValidaciÃ³n de ComunicaciÃ³n (Electron <-> Next.js)
 * Este script verifica la disponibilidad de servicios y la integridad del puente IPC.
 */
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');

const COLORS = {
  reset: "\x1b[0m",
  green: "\x1b[32m",
  red: "\x1b[31m",
  yellow: "\x1b[33m",
  cyan: "\x1b[36m"
};

async function validate() {
  console.log(`${COLORS.cyan}=== DIAGNÃ“STICO DE COMUNICACIÃ“N ADMIN.COM ===${COLORS.reset}\n`);

  // 1. Verificar Estructura de Archivos del Puente
  console.log(`[1/4] Verificando archivos del puente IPC...`);
  const files = ['electron-main.js', 'preload.js'];
  files.forEach(f => {
    const fullPath = path.join(process.cwd(), f);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      console.log(`  ${COLORS.green}âœ“${COLORS.reset} ${f} detectado.`);
    } else {
      console.log(`  ${COLORS.red}âœ—${COLORS.reset} NO SE ENCONTRÃ“ ${f}. El puente IPC no funcionarÃ¡.`);
    }
  });

  // 2. Verificar disponibilidad de Next.js
  console.log(`\n[2/4] Verificando servidor Next.js (Renderer)...`);
  await new Promise(resolve => {
    const req = http.get('http://localhost:3000', (res) => {
      console.log(`  ${COLORS.green}âœ“${COLORS.reset} Next.js activo en puerto 3000.`);
      resolve(true);
    });
    req.on('error', () => {
      console.log(`  ${COLORS.yellow}âš ${COLORS.reset} Next.js no responde en puerto 3000. (Ejecuta 'npm run dev' primero)`);
      resolve(false);
    });
    req.setTimeout(2000, () => {
      req.destroy();
      resolve(false);
    });
  });

  // 3. Verificar Entorno Electron
  console.log(`\n[3/4] Verificando binario de Electron...`);
  try {
    const version = execSync('npx electron --version', { stdio: 'pipe' }).toString().trim();
    console.log(`  ${COLORS.green}âœ“${COLORS.reset} Electron ${version} estÃ¡ listo para usarse.`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`  ${COLORS.red}âœ—${COLORS.reset} Error al invocar Electron. Revisa tus devDependencies.`);
  }

  // 4. Verificar Contrato Preload
  const preloadPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'preload.js');
  if (fs.existsSync(preloadPath)) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(preloadPath, 'utf8');
    if (content.includes('contextBridge') && content.includes('electronAPI')) {
      console.log(`\n[4/4] ${COLORS.green}âœ“ Puente contextBridge expuesto correctamente.${COLORS.reset}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`\n[4/4] ${COLORS.yellow}âš  Advertencia: preload.js no parece exponer 'electronAPI'.${COLORS.reset}`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`\n${COLORS.cyan}=============================================${COLORS.reset}`);
  console.log(`Para probar el puente en vivo, ejecuta: ${COLORS.green}npm run dev:electron${COLORS.reset}`);
  console.log(`${COLORS.cyan}=============================================${COLORS.reset}\n`);
}

validate();

import type { StateCreator } from 'zustand';
import type { ERPState, CartSlice } from './types';

import bunkkerConfig from '../../../bunkker.config.json';

const RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS = bunkkerConfig.reservation.timeoutMs;

/**
 * Transmite actualizaciÃ³n de reserva 0/1 entre pestaÃ±as/cajas a 0ms
 */
function broadcastReservationChange(productId: string, action: 'RESERVE' | 'RELEASE', quantity: number) {
    if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
        try {
            const bc = new BroadcastChannel('bunkker_tab_sync');
            bc.postMessage({
                type: 'POS_MUTEX_CHANGE',
                productId,
                action,
                quantity,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            });
            bc.close();
        } catch { }
    }
}

export const createCartSlice: StateCreator<
    ERPState,
    [['zustand/immer', never]],
    [],
    CartSlice
> = (set, get) => ({
    cart: [],
    isCartOpen: false,

    addToCart: (product, quantity = 1) =>
        set((state) => {
            const existing = state.cart.find((i: any) => i.id === product.id);
            const now = Date.now();
            if (existing) {
                if (existing.quantity + quantity > product.stock) return;
                existing.quantity += quantity;
                (existing as any).lastModified = now;
                (existing as any).reservedAt = now;
                (existing as any).mutexState = 1; // 1 = Reservado / In-flight (Mutex Multicaja)
            } else {
                state.cart.push({
                    ...product,
                    quantity,
                    lastModified: now,
                    reservedAt: now,
                    mutexState: 1 // 1 = Reservado / In-flight (Mutex Multicaja)
                } as any);
            }
            broadcastReservationChange(product.id, 'RESERVE', quantity);
        }),

    removeFromCart: (productId) =>
        set((state) => {
            const item = state.cart.find((i: any) => i.id === productId);
            if (item) {
                broadcastReservationChange(productId, 'RELEASE', item.quantity);
            }
            state.cart = state.cart.filter((i: any) => i.id !== productId);
        }),

    clearCart: () =>
        set((state) => {
            state.cart.forEach((item: any) => {
                broadcastReservationChange(item.id, 'RELEASE', item.quantity);
            });
            state.cart = [];
        }),

    cleanExpiredReservations: () =>
        set((state) => {
            const now = Date.now();
            const expired: string[] = [];
            state.cart = state.cart.filter((item: any) => {
                const reservedAt = item.reservedAt || item.lastModified || now;
                const isExpired = (now - reservedAt) > RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS;
                if (isExpired) {
                    expired.push(item.id);
                    broadcastReservationChange(item.id, 'RELEASE', item.quantity);
                }
                return !isExpired;
            });
            if (expired.length > 0) {
                console.warn(`[LFEDS Timer] â±ï¸ ${expired.length} reservas en carrito expiran de ${bunkkerConfig.reservation.timeoutMinutes || 30} minutos -> liberadas a Estado 0 (Estante)`);
            }
        }),

    openCart: () =>
        set((state) => {
            state.isCartOpen = true;
        }),

    closeCart: () =>
        set((state) => {
            state.isCartOpen = false;
        }),

    setCart: (cart) =>
        set((state) => {
            state.cart = cart;
        }),

    getTotal: () =>
        get().cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),

    getItemCount: () =>
        get().cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0),
});

import type { StateCreator } from 'zustand';

export const createProductsSlice: StateCreator<ERPState, [['zustand/immer', never]], [], ProductsSlice> = (set) => ({
    products: [],
    floatingStock: {},
    setProducts: (products) => set((state) => { state.products = products; }),
    setFloatingStock: (data) => set((state) => { state.floatingStock = data; }),
    addProduct: (product) => set((state) => { state.products.push(product as any); }),
    updateProduct: (product) => set((state) => { 
        const i = state.products.findIndex((p: any) => p.id === product.id);
        if (i !== -1) state.products[i] = product as any;
    }),
    deleteProduct: (id) => set((state) => { 
        state.products = state.products.filter((p: any) => p.id !== id);
    }),
});

export const createOrdersSlice: StateCreator<ERPState, [['zustand/immer', never]], [], OrdersSlice> = (set) => ({
    orders: [],
    setOrders: (orders) => set((state) => { state.orders = orders; }),
    claimOrder: (orderId, user) => set((state) => {
        const order = state.orders.find((o: any) => o.id === orderId);
        if (order) {
            order.claimedBy = user.name;
            order.claimedRole = user.role;
            order.claimedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            order.claimHistory = order.claimHistory || [];
            order.claimHistory.push({
                user: user.name,
                role: user.role,
                action: 'CLAIM',
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
    }),
    releaseOrder: (orderId, user, reason) => set((state) => {
        const order = state.orders.find((o: any) => o.id === orderId);
        if (order) {
            order.claimedBy = undefined;
            order.claimedRole = undefined;
            order.claimedAt = undefined;
            order.releaseReason = reason || 'Devuelto al pizarrÃ³n pÃºblico';
            order.recirculatedCount = (order.recirculatedCount || 0) + 1;
            order.claimHistory = order.claimHistory || [];
            order.claimHistory.push({
                user: user.name,
                role: user.role,
                action: 'RELEASE',
                reason: reason || 'Devuelto al pizarrÃ³n pÃºblico',
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
    }),
});

export const createFinanceSlice: StateCreator<ERPState, [['zustand/immer', never]], [], FinanceSlice> = (set) => ({
    ownerCredits: 0,
    ownerBalance: 0,
    maintenanceBalance: 0,
    setOwnerConfig: (credits, balance, maintenance) => set((state) => {
        state.ownerCredits = credits;
        state.ownerBalance = balance;
        state.maintenanceBalance = maintenance;
    }),
});

    siteConfig: defaultSiteConfig,

        const { currencySymbol = '$', currency = 'MXN' } = get().siteConfig;
        return `${currencySymbol}${amount.toLocaleString('es-MX', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2,
        })} ${currency}`;
    },
});

import type { StateCreator } from 'zustand';
import type { ERPState, UISlice } from './types';

export const createUISlice: StateCreator<ERPState, [['zustand/immer', never]], [], UISlice> = (set) => ({
    loading: true,
    firebaseStatus: 'connecting',
    guidedTourActive: false,
    guidedTourStep: 1,
    hasCustomizedCanvas: false,
    hasPublishedCanvas: false,
    hasAddedProductToSimulator: false,
    hasPaidInSimulator: false,

    setLoading: (loading) => set((state) => { state.loading = loading; }),
    setFirebaseStatus: (status) => set((state) => { state.firebaseStatus = status; }),

    startGuidedTour: () => set((state) => {
        state.guidedTourActive = true;
        state.guidedTourStep = 1;
        state.hasCustomizedCanvas = false;
        state.hasPublishedCanvas = false;
        state.hasAddedProductToSimulator = false;
        state.hasPaidInSimulator = false;
    }),
    nextGuidedTourStep: () => set((state) => { state.guidedTourStep = Math.min(state.guidedTourStep + 1, 6); }),
    prevGuidedTourStep: () => set((state) => { state.guidedTourStep = Math.max(state.guidedTourStep - 1, 1); }),
    stopGuidedTour: () => set((state) => { state.guidedTourActive = false; }),
    setGuidedTourStep: (step) => set((state) => { state.guidedTourStep = step; }),
    setHasCustomizedCanvas: (val) => set((state) => { state.hasCustomizedCanvas = val; }),
    setHasPublishedCanvas: (val) => set((state) => { state.hasPublishedCanvas = val; }),
    setHasAddedProductToSimulator: (val) => set((state) => { state.hasAddedProductToSimulator = val; }),
    setHasPaidInSimulator: (val) => set((state) => { state.hasPaidInSimulator = val; }),
});

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';

interface AuthState {
    isAuthenticated: boolean;
    user: { id: string; name: string; role: string } | null;
    login: (password: string) => boolean;
    logout: () => void;
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>()(
    persist(
        (set) => ({
            isAuthenticated: false,
            user: null,
            login: (password: string) => {
                // ContraseÃ±a maestra local definida en .env como LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
                const masterPassword = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD;
                if (masterPassword && password === masterPassword) { 
                    set({ isAuthenticated: true, user: { id: 'local-admin', name: 'Administrador Local', role: 'admin' } });
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            },
            logout: () => set({ isAuthenticated: false, user: null }),
        }),
        { name: 'local-session-storage' }
    )
);

ARCHIVO: src\store\useCartSync.ts
================================================================================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { doc, onSnapshot, setDoc, serverTimestamp, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';
import { useERPStore } from '@/store/useERPStore';
import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
import { type CartItem } from '@/context/CartContext';

export function useCartSync() {
    const { user, isPremium } = useAuth();
    const cart = useERPStore(state => state.cart);
    const setCart = useERPStore(state => state.setCart);
    
    // Ref para tener siempre el valor mÃ¡s reciente del carrito sin disparar efectos
    const latestCartRef = useRef(cart);
    useEffect(() => {
        latestCartRef.current = cart;
    }, [cart]);

    // 1. ESCUCHAR cambios desde Firestore (Nube -> Local)
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!user || !isPremium) return;

        const cartRef = doc(db, 'users', user.uid, 'cart', 'current');
        const unsub = onSnapshot(cartRef, (docSnap: any) => {
            if (docSnap.exists()) {
                const remoteCart = docSnap.data().items || [];
                
                const localStr = JSON.stringify(latestCartRef.current);
                const remoteStr = JSON.stringify(remoteCart);

                if (localStr !== remoteStr) {
                    const mergedCart = [...latestCartRef.current];
                    
                    remoteCart.forEach((remoteItem: any) => {
                        const localIndex = mergedCart.findIndex(i => i.id === remoteItem.id);
                        if (localIndex > -1) {
                            if ((remoteItem.lastModified || 0) > ((mergedCart[localIndex] as any).lastModified || 0)) {
                                mergedCart[localIndex] = remoteItem;
                            }
                        } else {
                            mergedCart.push(remoteItem);
                        }
                    });

                    setCart(mergedCart);
                }
            }
        });

        return () => unsub();
    }, [user, isPremium, setCart]); 

    // 2. GUARDAR cambios en Firestore (Local -> Nube)
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!user || !isPremium) return;

        const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
            const cartRef = doc(db, 'users', user.uid, 'cart', 'current');
            try {
                await setDoc(cartRef, { items: cart, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Error syncing cart to Firestore:", err);
            }
        }, 1000); // Debounce de 1 segundo

        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [cart, user, isPremium]);
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';

export interface LocalDeliveryOrder {
  id: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerRole?: string;
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  status: 'PENDING_DELIVERY' | 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' | 'DELIVERED' | 'REJECTED';
  deliveryPin?: string;
  items: any[];
  total: number;
  // Evidence
  signatureData?: string | null;
  photoData?: string | null;
  completedAt?: string;
}

interface DeliveryState {
  isRouteActive: boolean;
  warehouseLocation: [number, number];
  activeOrders: LocalDeliveryOrder[];
  routeIndices: number[];
  
  // Actions
  startRoute: (order: LocalDeliveryOrder[], indices: number[]) => void;
  endRoute: () => void;
  completeDelivery: (orderId: string, signatureData?: string | null, photoData?: string | null) => void;
  rejectDelivery: (orderId: string, reason: string) => void;
  getPendingSyncOrders: () => LocalDeliveryOrder[];
}

export const useDeliveryStore = create<DeliveryState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isRouteActive: false,
      warehouseLocation: [19.4326, -99.1332], // Configurable o sacado del ERP
      activeOrders: [],
      routeIndices: [],

      startRoute: (order, indices) => set({
        isRouteActive: true,
        activeOrders: order,
        routeIndices: indices
      }),

      endRoute: () => set({
        isRouteActive: false,
        activeOrders: [],
        routeIndices: []
      }),

      completeDelivery: (orderId, signatureData, photoData) => set((state) => ({
        activeOrders: state.activeOrders.map(o => 
          o.id === orderId 
            ? { ...o, status: 'DELIVERED', signatureData, photoData, completedAt: new Date().toISOString() } 
            : o
        )
      })),

      rejectDelivery: (orderId, reason) => set((state) => ({
        activeOrders: state.activeOrders.map(o => 
          o.id === orderId 
            ? { ...o, status: 'REJECTED', completedAt: new Date().toISOString(), rejectReason: reason } 
            : o
        )
      })),

      getPendingSyncOrders: () => {
        return get().activeOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'DELIVERED' || o.status === 'REJECTED');
      }
    }),
    {
      name: 'bunkker-delivery-offline-storage', // key in local storage
    }
  )
);

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useStoreHydrated<T, F>(
    store: (callback: (state: T) => unknown) => unknown,
    selector: (state: T) => F
): F | undefined {
    const result = store(selector) as F;
    const [data, setData] = useState<F>();

    useEffect(() => {
        let isMounted = true;
        Promise.resolve().then(() => {
            if (isMounted) setData(result);
        });
        return () => { isMounted = false; };
    }, [result]);

    return data;
}

ARCHIVO: src\worker\worker.ts

import { config } from 'dotenv';
config({ path: '.env.local' });

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getFirestore, doc, setDoc, updateDoc, increment, getDoc, disableNetwork, enableNetwork } from 'firebase/firestore';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

// ConfiguraciÃ³n leÃ­da de .env.local
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY,
  authDomain: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,
  projectId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
  storageBucket: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
  messagingSenderId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,
  appId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = getFirestore(app);

// â”€â”€â”€ Estado de red y backoff exponencial â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
let _networkOk = true;
let _reconnectBackoffMs = 2_000;
const MAX_BACKOFF_MS = 120_000; // 2 minutos mÃ¡ximo

/** Detecta si un error es de red transitoria (TCP abortado, wsarecv, etc.) */
function isNetworkError(err: any): boolean {
  const msg = String(err?.message ?? err ?? '');
  return (
    msg.includes('stream reading error') ||
    msg.includes('wsarecv') ||
    msg.includes('WebChannelConnection') ||
    msg.includes('transport errored') ||
    msg.includes('UNAVAILABLE') ||
    msg.includes('ECONNRESET') ||
    msg.includes('ENOTFOUND') ||
    msg.includes('ETIMEDOUT')
  );
}

/** Reconecta Firestore con backoff exponencial */
async function reconnectFirestore(): Promise<void> {
  console.warn(`âš ï¸  [Worker] Red cortÃ³. Reconectando en ${_reconnectBackoffMs / 1000}s...`);
  _networkOk = false;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, _reconnectBackoffMs));
  try {
    await disableNetwork(db);
    await enableNetwork(db);
    _networkOk = true;
    _reconnectBackoffMs = 2_000; // reset
    console.log('âœ… [Worker] Reconectado a Firebase.');
  } catch {
    _reconnectBackoffMs = Math.min(_reconnectBackoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
  }
}

console.log("ðŸš€ [Worker] Iniciando Background Sync Worker...");

async function processQueue() {
    // Si la red estÃ¡ caida, saltar este ciclo
    if (!_networkOk) return;

    try {
        // 1. Buscar registros pendientes o que fallaron anteriormente
        const pendingTasks = await prisma.syncQueue.findMany({
            where: {
                status: { in: ['PENDING', 'FAILED'] }
            },
            orderBy: {
                createdAt: 'asc'
            },
            take: 10 // Procesar en lotes de 10
        });

        if (pendingTasks.length === 0) {
            return; // Nada que hacer
        }

        console.log(`[Worker] Encontradas ${pendingTasks.length} tareas pendientes.`);

        // 2. Procesar cada tarea
        for (const task of pendingTasks) {
            console.log(`[Worker] Procesando tarea ${task.id} - ${task.action} en ${task.collection}`);
            
            // Cambiar a PROCESSING para evitar colisiones
            await prisma.syncQueue.update({
                where: { id: task.id },
                data: { status: 'PROCESSING' }
            });

            try {
                const payload = JSON.parse(task.payload);

                if (task.collection === 'orders' && task.action === 'CREATE') {
                    const docId = task.documentId || task.id;
                    await setDoc(doc(db, 'orders', docId), {
                        ...payload,
                        syncedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                    });

                    if (payload.items && Array.isArray(payload.items)) {
                        for (const item of payload.items) {
                            try {
                                await updateDoc(doc(db, 'products', item.id), {
                                    stock: increment(-item.quantity),
                                    syncedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                                });
                            } catch (err) {}
                        }
                    }

                    if (payload.localOrderId) {
                        await prisma.order.update({
                            where: { id: payload.localOrderId },
                            data: { synced: true }
                        });
                    }
                } else if (task.collection === 'invoices' && task.action === 'CREATE') {
                    const Facturapi = require('facturapi').default || require('facturapi');
                    let apiKey = process.env.FACTURAPI_KEY;

                    // Evitar bucles infinitos: cancelar tarea si pasa de 5 intentos
                    const attempts = payload._attempts || 0;
                    if (attempts >= 5) {
                        await prisma.syncQueue.update({
                            where: { id: task.id },
                            data: { 
                                status: 'FAILED_PERMANENTLY',
                                errorMsg: 'Superado el lÃ­mite de 5 intentos automÃ¡ticos. Error de cliente permanente (RFC o datos invÃ¡lidos).'
                            }
                        });
                        console.log(`[Worker] âŒ Tarea ${task.id} de facturaciÃ³n cancelada permanentemente (5 reintentos fallidos).`);
                        continue;
                    }

                    try {
                        const secretSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'tenants', payload.tenantId || 'default', 'secrets', 'keys'));
                        if (secretSnap.exists() && secretSnap.data()?.facturapi_key) {
                            apiKey = secretSnap.data().facturapi_key;
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error("[Worker] Error leyendo keys de firestore para reintento:", e);
                    }

                    if (!apiKey) {
                        throw new Error("API Key de Facturapi no disponible en el entorno del worker.");
                    }

                    const facturapiInstance = new Facturapi(apiKey);
                    const invoice = await facturapiInstance.invoices.create({
                        customer: payload.customer,
                        items: payload.items,
                        payment_form: payload.payment_form,
                        use: payload.use,
                        type: payload.type,
                    });

                    console.log(`[Worker] âœ… Factura creada con Ã©xito en Facturapi (Reintento) ID: ${invoice.id}`);
                } else if (task.action === 'UPDATE' || task.action === 'UPSERT') {
                    const docId = task.documentId || task.id;
                    await setDoc(doc(db, task.collection, docId), {
                        ...payload,
                        syncedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                    }, { merge: true });
                } else if (task.action === 'DELETE') {
                    // Firebase deleteDoc is imported? We need it, or we just set it as deleted.
                    const docId = task.documentId || task.id;
                    await setDoc(doc(db, task.collection, docId), {
                        deleted: true,
                        syncedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                    }, { merge: true });
                }

                // Si todo sale bien, ELIMINAMOS la tarea para ahorrar espacio local
                await prisma.syncQueue.delete({
                    where: { id: task.id }
                });

                console.log(`[Worker] âœ… Tarea ${task.id} completada y eliminada.`);
            } catch (err: any) {
                // P2025 = Record to update/delete not found (ya lo procesÃ³ otro hilo)
                if (err.code === 'P2025') {
                    console.log(`[Worker] âš ï¸ Tarea ${task.id} ya no existe (procesada por otro hilo).`);
                    continue;
                }

                console.error(`[Worker] âŒ Error procesando tarea ${task.id}:`, err.message);
                // Si falla, incrementamos intentos si es factura y lo devolvemos a FAILED con el mensaje de error
                try {
                    let nextPayload = task.payload;
                    if (task.collection === 'invoices') {
                        try {
                            const parsed = JSON.parse(task.payload);
                            parsed._attempts = (parsed._attempts || 0) + 1;
                            nextPayload = JSON.stringify(parsed);
                        } catch (e) {}
                    }

                    await prisma.syncQueue.update({
                        where: { id: task.id },
                        data: { 
                            status: 'FAILED',
                            payload: nextPayload,
                            errorMsg: err.message
                        }
                    });
                } catch (updateErr: any) {
                    if (updateErr.code !== 'P2025') {
                        console.error(`[Worker] Error crÃ­tico al actualizar tarea a FAILED:`, updateErr.message);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (e: any) {
        if (isNetworkError(e)) {
            // Error de TCP/stream â€” reconectar silenciosamente con backoff
            reconnectFirestore(); // No await â€” el siguiente ciclo verÃ¡ _networkOk=false
        } else {
            console.error("[Worker] Error crÃ­tico en el ciclo de proceso:", e);
        }
    }
}

// Ejecutar cada 10 segundos
setInterval(processQueue, 10000);

// Ejecutar una vez al inicio
processQueue();

ARCHIVO: src\__tests__\concurrency_stock_race.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
 * BUNKKER E.C.O.S â€” Concurrency & Stock Race Forensics Test (Axioma 11)
 * â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
 * 
 * Prueba de fuego para auditar:
 * 1. Carrera AAA / BBB / CCC: 3 peticiones simultÃ¡neas sobre producto con stock = 1.
 * 2. Idempotencia persistente en BD: Evitar doble cobro o doble descuento de stock.
 * 3. Fail-Closed: Bloqueo inmediato ante falla de base de datos o usuario inactivo.
 */

describe('Stock Concurrency Race & Idempotency Forensics', () => {

  // SimulaciÃ³n del motor transaccional ACID de SQLite
  class MockSqliteDb {
    public stock: number;
    public reservedStock: number;
    public orders: Map<string, any>;
    private lock: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

    constructor(initialStock: number = 1) {
      this.stock = initialStock;
      this.reservedStock = 0;
      this.orders = new Map();
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta una transacciÃ³n serializada (tal como SQLite Serializable / BEGIN IMMEDIATE)
     */
    async executeTransaction<T>(fn: (tx: any) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
      // Cola de serializaciÃ³n estricta de escrituras en SQLite
      const currentLock = this.lock;
      let releaseLock: () => void = () => {};
      this.lock = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        releaseLock = resolve;
      });

      await currentLock;
      const snapshotStock = this.stock;
      const snapshotReserved = this.reservedStock;
      try {
        const txContext = {
          findProduct: async (id: string) => {
            return { id, stock: this.stock, reservedStock: this.reservedStock };
          },
          decrementStock: async (id: string, qty: number) => {
            this.stock -= qty;
          },
          findOrder: async (id: string) => {
            return this.orders.get(id) || null;
          },
          createOrder: async (order: any) => {
            if (this.orders.has(order.id)) {
              const err: any = new Error('Unique constraint failed on the fields: (`id`)');
              err.code = 'P2002';
              throw err;
            }
            this.orders.set(order.id, order);
            return order;
          }
        };

        const result = await fn(txContext);
        return result;
      } catch (txError) {
        // ACID ROLLBACK: En caso de error o colisiÃ³n (P2002), se revierten las mutaciones
        this.stock = snapshotStock;
        this.reservedStock = snapshotReserved;
        throw txError;
      } finally {
        releaseLock();
      }
    }
  }

  it('Carrera AAA / BBB / CCC: 3 peticiones simultÃ¡neas compiten por 1 unidad de stock', async () => {
    const db = new MockSqliteDb(1); // 1 unidad disponible
    const productId = 'prod-martillo-001';

    // FunciÃ³n que replica la lÃ³gica transaccional de /api/orders
    const processSale = async (workerId: string, orderId: string, quantity: number) => {
      return db.executeTransaction(async (tx) => {
        // 1. Leer stock dentro de la transacciÃ³n
        const product = await tx.findProduct(productId);
        const available = product.stock - product.reservedStock;

        // 2. Validar disponibilidad
        if (available < quantity) {
          throw new Error(`[${workerId}] Inventario insuficiente. Disponible: ${available}, Solicitado: ${quantity}`);
        }

        // 3. Decrementar stock
        await tx.decrementStock(productId, quantity);

        // 4. Crear orden
        const order = await tx.createOrder({
          id: orderId,
          productId,
          quantity,
          workerId,
          status: 'paid'
        });

        return { success: true, order };
      });
    };

    console.log('[CONCURRENCY TEST] ðŸ Lanzando 3 peticiones simultÃ¡neas (AAA, BBB, CCC) para comprar la Ãºltima unidad...');

    // Lanzar 3 peticiones concurrentes a travÃ©s de Promise.allSettled
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      processSale('AAA', 'ord-001', 1),
      processSale('BBB', 'ord-002', 1),
      processSale('CCC', 'ord-003', 1),
    ]);

    const fulfilled = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled');
    const rejected = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected');

    console.log(`[CONCURRENCY TEST] âœ… Ã‰xitos: ${fulfilled.length}, Rechazos controlados: ${rejected.length}`);
    console.log(`[CONCURRENCY TEST] ðŸ“¦ Stock final en SQLite: ${db.stock}`);

    // EXACTAMENTE 1 debe tener Ã©xito
    expect(fulfilled.length).toBe(1);
    // EXACTAMENTE 2 deben ser rechazadas con error de stock insuficiente
    expect(rejected.length).toBe(2);
    // El stock no debe quedar negativo bajo ninguna circunstancia
    expect(db.stock).toBe(0);
    // Solo 1 orden debe haber quedado registrada
    expect(db.orders.size).toBe(1);

    // Verificar que los errores contengan el mensaje de inventario insuficiente
    rejected.forEach((r: any) => {
      expect(r.reason.message).toContain('Inventario insuficiente');
    });
  });

  it('Idempotencia concurrente con colisiÃ³n de Primary Key (P2002)', async () => {
    const db = new MockSqliteDb(5);
    const orderId = 'tx-same-order-123';

    const simulatePostOrder = async (workerId: string) => {
      // 1. Check idempotencia inicial
      const existing = await db.orders.get(orderId);
      if (existing) {
        return { success: true, data: existing, duplicated: true };
      }

      try {
        return await db.executeTransaction(async (tx) => {
          const product = await tx.findProduct('prod-1');
          if (product.stock < 1) throw new Error('Sin stock');

          await tx.decrementStock('prod-1', 1);
          const order = await tx.createOrder({ id: orderId, workerId });
          return { success: true, data: order, duplicated: false };
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        // Manejador P2002 de /api/orders
        if (err.code === 'P2002') {
          const recovered = await db.orders.get(orderId);
          return { success: true, data: recovered, duplicated: true };
        }
        throw err;
      }
    };

    // Dos peticiones disparadas simultÃ¡neamente con el MISMO orderId
    const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
      simulatePostOrder('Req-1'),
      simulatePostOrder('Req-2')
    ]);

    expect(res1.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res2.success).toBe(true);

    // Una fue la creaciÃ³n real, la otra fue identificada como duplicada
    const duplicates = [res1, res2].filter(r => r.duplicated);
    const originals = [res1, res2].filter(r => !r.duplicated);

    expect(originals.length).toBe(1);
    expect(duplicates.length).toBe(1);

    // El stock debe haberse descontado EXACTAMENTE 1 vez (5 - 1 = 4), NUNCA 2 veces
    expect(db.stock).toBe(4);
    expect(db.orders.size).toBe(1);
  });

  it('Fail-Closed: Usuarios inactivos o base de datos corrupta rechazan la venta sin tocar stock', async () => {

        return { status: 401, error: 'Usuario inactivo' };

      return { status: 200, success: true };

    const resDbDown = executeSaleWithAuth({ active: true }, false);
    expect(resDbDown.status).toBe(503);
    expect(stock).toBe(10);

    // Caso 2: Usuario dado de baja (active = false) -> 401, stock intacto
    const resInactive = executeSaleWithAuth({ active: false }, true);
    expect(resInactive.status).toBe(401);
    expect(stock).toBe(10);

    // Caso 3: Usuario activo con DB sana -> 200, stock decrementado a 9
    const resValid = executeSaleWithAuth({ active: true }, true);
    expect(resValid.status).toBe(200);
    expect(stock).toBe(9);

  it('Concurrencia + Fallo + RecuperaciÃ³n: AAA gana, BBB falla a mitad de camino y el estado final permanece Ã­ntegro', async () => {

  it('Aislamiento Soberano de Tenant: Header x-tenant-id falsificado es completamente ignorado', () => {

  it('DesambiguaciÃ³n estricta: P2002 PK vs P2034 Busy (Errores con texto "conflict" NO devuelven falso 200)', () => {
    const existingOrders = new Map<string, any>();
    existingOrders.set('ord-completada', { id: 'ord-completada', total: 100 });

    const handleCatchBlock = (error: any, collisionId: string) => {
      // 1. P2002 PK
      const isOrderPkCollision = error.code === 'P2002' || (
        typeof error.message === 'string' &&
        error.message.includes('Unique constraint failed') &&
        (!error.meta?.target || (Array.isArray(error.meta.target) && error.meta.target.includes('id')))
      );

      if (isOrderPkCollision && collisionId) {
        const existing = existingOrders.get(collisionId);
        if (existing) {
          return { status: 200, success: true, data: existing, duplicated: true };
        }
      }

      // 2. P2034 / SQLITE_BUSY
      const isBusyOrLockConflict = error.code === 'P2034' || 
        (typeof error.message === 'string' && (
          error.message.includes('SQLITE_BUSY') || 
          error.message.includes('database is locked') ||
          error.message.includes('Transaction failed due to a write conflict')
        ));

      if (isBusyOrLockConflict) {
        if (collisionId) {
          const existing = existingOrders.get(collisionId);
          if (existing) {
            return { status: 200, success: true, data: existing, duplicated: true };
          }
        }
        return { status: 409, success: false, retryable: true, error: 'Conflicto de concurrencia' };
      }

      return { status: 500, success: false, error: error.message };
    };

    // Caso A: Error genÃ©rico no relacionado pero que contiene la palabra "conflict"
    // (Ej. "Conflict in third-party tax calculation")
    const genericConflictError = new Error('Validation conflict in custom pricing rules');
    const resA = handleCatchBlock(genericConflictError, 'ord-nueva-1');
    // NO debe devolver 200, debe devolver 500
    expect(resA.status).toBe(500);
    expect(resA.success).toBe(false);

    // Caso B: P2034 con orden NO existente todavÃ­a
    const busyErrorNoOrder = { code: 'P2034', message: 'Transaction failed due to a write conflict' };
    const resB = handleCatchBlock(busyErrorNoOrder, 'ord-nueva-2');
    // Debe devolver 409 reintentable
    expect(resB.status).toBe(409);
    expect(resB.retryable).toBe(true);

    // Caso C: P2034 o P2002 pero la orden ya quedÃ³ asentada en BD por la peticiÃ³n ganadora
    const busyErrorWithOrder = { code: 'P2034', message: 'Transaction failed due to a write conflict' };
    const resC = handleCatchBlock(busyErrorWithOrder, 'ord-completada');
    // Debe devolver 200 con la orden y duplicated: true
    expect(resC.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resC.duplicated).toBe(true);
  });

  it('Ciclo de vida de reservedStock: CancelaciÃ³n de Venta Mostrador (LOCAL) vs Pedido (PICKUP)', () => {
    // Escenario 1: Venta mostrador (deliveryType = LOCAL, pago directo)
    // En la creaciÃ³n, se descontÃ³ directamente de stock (stock 10 -> 9, reservedStock 0)
    let stockLocal = 9;
    let reservedLocal = 0;
    const orderLocal = { deliveryType: 'LOCAL', status: 'COMPLETED', confirmedAt: new Date(), quantity: 1 };

    // Al cancelar la venta local:
    const wasPhysicalStockDeducted = orderLocal.status === 'COMPLETED' || orderLocal.deliveryType === 'LOCAL';
    if (wasPhysicalStockDeducted) {
      stockLocal += orderLocal.quantity;
    } else {
      reservedLocal -= orderLocal.quantity;
    }

    // El stock fÃ­sico debe restaurarse a 10 y reservedStock permanecer en 0
    expect(stockLocal).toBe(10);
    expect(reservedLocal).toBe(0);

    // Escenario 2: Pedido Pickup (deliveryType = PICKUP)
    // Al cobrar en caja, stock fÃ­sico permanece en 10 y reservedStock sube a 1
    let stockPickup = 10;
    let reservedPickup = 1;
    const orderPickup = { deliveryType: 'PICKUP', status: 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID', confirmedAt: new Date(), quantity: 1 };

    // Al cancelar el pedido pickup antes de entregarlo:
    const wasPickupPhysicalDeducted = orderPickup.status === 'DELIVERED' || orderPickup.status === 'COMPLETED';
    if (wasPickupPhysicalDeducted) {
      stockPickup += orderPickup.quantity;
    } else {
      reservedPickup -= orderPickup.quantity;
    }

    // El stock fÃ­sico sigue en 10 (nunca saliÃ³ de tienda) y reservedStock baja a 0 (se libera el apartado)
    expect(stockPickup).toBe(10);
    expect(reservedPickup).toBe(0);

    // Escenario 3: Pedido Pickup se entrega al cliente (DELIVERED)
    // Al entregar, se descuenta de stock fÃ­sico y se descuenta de reservedStock
    stockPickup -= orderPickup.quantity;
    reservedPickup = 0;
    expect(stockPickup).toBe(9);
    expect(reservedPickup).toBe(0);
  });

});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateExpectedAmount, calculateDiscrepancy, ALLOWED_CLOSE_STATUSES } from '../lib/financial';

describe('Financial Cash Close Calculations', () => {
  describe('calculateExpectedAmount', () => {
    it('should sum all cash orders with allowed status', () => {
      const mockOrders = [
        { total: 100, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'COMPLETED' },
        { total: 250, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'DELIVERED' },
        { total: 150, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'READY_TO_SHIP' },
        { total: 300, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' },
      ];
      
      const expected = calculateExpectedAmount(mockOrders);
      expect(expected).toBe(800);
    });

    it('should ignore orders with non-cash payment methods', () => {
      const mockOrders = [
        { total: 100, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'COMPLETED' },
        { total: 500, paymentMethod: 'card', status: 'COMPLETED' },
        { total: 200, paymentMethod: 'transfer', status: 'COMPLETED' },
      ];

      const expected = calculateExpectedAmount(mockOrders);
      expect(expected).toBe(100);
    });

    it('should ignore orders with disallowed statuses', () => {
      const mockOrders = [
        { total: 100, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'COMPLETED' },
        { total: 500, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'PENDING_PAYMENT' },
        { total: 200, paymentMethod: 'cash', status: 'CANCELLED' },
      ];

      const expected = calculateExpectedAmount(mockOrders);
      expect(expected).toBe(100);
    });

    it('should return 0 for an empty orders list', () => {
      const expected = calculateExpectedAmount([]);
      expect(expected).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('calculateDiscrepancy', () => {
    it('should return 0 when declared amount equals expected amount', () => {
      const discrepancy = calculateDiscrepancy(1000, 1000);
      expect(discrepancy).toBe(0);
    });

    it('should return a negative value when there is a deficit', () => {
      const discrepancy = calculateDiscrepancy(850, 1000);
      expect(discrepancy).toBe(-150);
    });

    it('should return a positive value when there is a surplus', () => {
      const discrepancy = calculateDiscrepancy(1120, 1000);
      expect(discrepancy).toBe(120);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

/**
 * â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
 * BUNKKER E.C.O.S â€” Tests de MÃ¡quina de Estados del Pedido (Order FSM)
 * â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
 *
 * Valida los 3 caminos que un carrito/pedido puede tomar a travÃ©s de sus
 * estados, mÃ¡s los flujos transversales (cancelaciÃ³n, expiraciÃ³n, NIGHT_QUEUE).
 *
 * CAMINO 1: VENTA LOCAL / TIENDA (deliveryType = 'LOCAL')
 *   Cajero vende directo â†’ paid â†’ COMPLETED
 *   Cliente solicita â†’ pending_payment â†’ [cajero cobra] â†’ paid â†’ COMPLETED
 *
 * CAMINO 2: DELIVERY / REPARTIDOR (deliveryType = 'DELIVERY')
 *   pending_payment â†’ PREPARANDO â†’ READY_TO_SHIP â†’ [pago] â†’ OUT_FOR_DELIVERY â†’ claimed â†’ DELIVERED
 *
 * CAMINO 3: PICKUP / PATIO (deliveryType = 'PICKUP' o 'PATIO')
 *   pending_payment â†’ PREPARANDO â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP â†’ [pago] â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID â†’ DELIVERED
 *
 * TRANSVERSAL: CancelaciÃ³n (cualquier estado no-terminal â†’ cancelled)
 * TRANSVERSAL: ExpiraciÃ³n (reserva vencida â†’ cancelled por SYSTEM)
 * TRANSVERSAL: NIGHT_QUEUE (fuera de horario â†’ cola nocturna)
 */

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// DefiniciÃ³n de la MÃ¡quina de Estados (extraÃ­da del API /api/orders)
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

/** Todos los estados posibles de un pedido */
type OrderStatus =
  | 'pending_payment'       // Solicitud creada, esperando pago en caja
  | 'pending_confirmation'  // ConfirmaciÃ³n pendiente
  | 'NIGHT_QUEUE'           // Creado fuera de horario, espera apertura
  | 'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA'     // Cliente en camino a recoger
  | 'paid'                  // Pagado (venta directa o pago confirmado)
  | 'PREPARANDO'            // AlmacÃ©n preparando el pedido
  | 'READY_TO_SHIP'         // Preparado, listo para ruta (delivery)
  | 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'      // Preparado, listo para recolecciÃ³n (no pagado)
  | 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID' // Preparado y pagado, listo para entregar (pickup)
  | 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'      // En ruta de entrega
  | 'claimed'               // Repartidor tomÃ³ el pedido
  | 'DELIVERED'             // Entregado al cliente
  | 'COMPLETED'             // Venta local completada
  | 'cancelled'             // Cancelado (terminal)
  | 'rejected'              // Rechazado por repartidor (terminal)
  | 'no_answer'             // Cliente no responde (terminal)
  ;

type DeliveryType = 'LOCAL' | 'DELIVERY' | 'PICKUP' | 'PATIO';

interface OrderState {
  status: OrderStatus;
  deliveryType: DeliveryType;
  confirmedAt: Date | null;    // null = no pagado
  isLoaded: boolean;           // true = almacÃ©n terminÃ³ de preparar
  vendedorId: string | null;   // cajero que tomÃ³ el pedido
  assignedDriverId: string | null;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
}

/** Acciones posibles sobre un pedido (API PATCH actions) */
type OrderAction =
  | 'claim_cashier'           // Cajero toma el pedido
  | 'cashier_payment'         // Cajero confirma cobro
  | 'claim_loading'           // Almacenista inicia preparaciÃ³n
  | 'complete_loading'        // Almacenista termina de preparar
  | 'claim_delivery'          // Repartidor toma la ruta
  | 'confirm_pickup_receipt'  // Mostrador entrega al cliente
  | 'cancel'                  // Cancelar pedido
  ;

/**
 * Determina el siguiente estado tras completar la carga (complete_loading).
 * LÃ³gica extraÃ­da de /api/orders PATCH action='complete_loading'
 */
function nextStatusAfterLoading(deliveryType: DeliveryType, isPaid: boolean): OrderStatus {
  const isPickup = ['PICKUP', 'PATIO'].includes(deliveryType);
  const isDelivery = deliveryType === 'DELIVERY';

  if (isPickup) {
    return isPaid ? 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID' : 'READY_FOR_PICKUP';
  }
  if (isDelivery) {
    return isPaid ? 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' : 'READY_TO_SHIP';
  }
  // LOCAL
  return 'COMPLETED';
}

/**
 * Determina el siguiente estado tras el pago del cajero (cashier_payment).
 * LÃ³gica extraÃ­da de /api/orders PATCH action='cashier_payment'
 */
function nextStatusAfterPayment(deliveryType: DeliveryType, isLoaded: boolean): OrderStatus {
  const isPickup = ['PICKUP', 'PATIO'].includes(deliveryType);
  const isDelivery = deliveryType === 'DELIVERY';

  if (isLoaded) {
    if (isDelivery) return 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY';
    if (isPickup) return 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID';
    return 'COMPLETED';
  }
  return 'paid';
}

/** Estados desde los cuales el cajero puede cobrar */
const CASHIER_READY_STATUSES: OrderStatus[] = ['READY_TO_SHIP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'];

/** Estados desde los cuales el almacenista puede preparar */
const LOADING_STATUSES: OrderStatus[] = ['pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'paid', 'PREPARANDO', 'NIGHT_QUEUE', 'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA'];

/** Estados que permiten expiraciÃ³n automÃ¡tica */
const EXPIRABLE_STATUSES: OrderStatus[] = ['pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'NIGHT_QUEUE', 'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA', 'PREPARANDO', 'READY_TO_SHIP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP'];

/** Estados terminales â€” no se puede hacer nada mÃ¡s */
const TERMINAL_STATUSES: OrderStatus[] = ['DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED', 'cancelled', 'rejected', 'no_answer'];

/** Verifica si se puede cancelar (no es terminal) */
function canCancel(status: OrderStatus): boolean {
  return !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(status);
}

/** Estado inicial segÃºn tipo de venta */
function getInitialStatus(asRequest: boolean, isNightQueue: boolean): OrderStatus {
  if (isNightQueue) return 'NIGHT_QUEUE';
  return asRequest ? 'pending_payment' : 'paid';
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// TESTS
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

describe('Order FSM â€” CAMINO 1: Venta Local / Tienda (LOCAL)', () => {

  it('Venta directa en caja â†’ paid â†’ COMPLETED inmediato', () => {
    // Cajero escanea, cobra y entrega al instante
    const initial = getInitialStatus(false, false);
    expect(initial).toBe('paid');

    // Al completar carga local (si aplica), cierra como COMPLETED
    const afterLoading = nextStatusAfterLoading('LOCAL', true);
    expect(afterLoading).toBe('COMPLETED');
  });

  it('Cliente solicita â†’ pending_payment â†’ cajero cobra â†’ paid', () => {
    const initial = getInitialStatus(true, false);
    expect(initial).toBe('pending_payment');

    // El cajero cobra antes de que almacÃ©n cargue â†’ paid (no COMPLETED aÃºn)
    const afterPayment = nextStatusAfterPayment('LOCAL', false);
    expect(afterPayment).toBe('paid');
  });

  it('Solicitud + carga completada + pago â†’ COMPLETED', () => {
    const initial = getInitialStatus(true, false);
    expect(initial).toBe('pending_payment');

    // AlmacÃ©n carga pero aÃºn no paga
    const afterLoading = nextStatusAfterLoading('LOCAL', false);
    // LOCAL con pago => COMPLETED, sin pago el flujo sigue
    expect(afterLoading).toBe('COMPLETED');
    // Nota: en LOCAL, el flujo es corto â€” la carga cierra el ciclo
  });

  it('NIGHT_QUEUE se crea fuera de horario', () => {
    const initial = getInitialStatus(true, true);
    expect(initial).toBe('NIGHT_QUEUE');
  });
});


describe('Order FSM â€” CAMINO 2: Delivery / Repartidor (DELIVERY)', () => {

  it('Flujo completo: pending_payment â†’ carga â†’ READY_TO_SHIP â†’ pago â†’ OUT_FOR_DELIVERY â†’ claimed â†’ DELIVERED', () => {
    // 1. Cliente hace pedido online
    const step1 = getInitialStatus(true, false);
    expect(step1).toBe('pending_payment');

    // 2. Almacenista prepara el pedido (aÃºn no pagado)
    expect(LOADING_STATUSES).toContain('pending_payment');
    const step2 = nextStatusAfterLoading('DELIVERY', false);
    expect(step2).toBe('READY_TO_SHIP');

    // 3. Cajero cobra
    expect(CASHIER_READY_STATUSES).toContain('READY_TO_SHIP');
    // isLoaded = true porque almacÃ©n ya terminÃ³
    const step3 = nextStatusAfterPayment('DELIVERY', true);
    expect(step3).toBe('OUT_FOR_DELIVERY');

    // 4. Repartidor toma y entrega â†’ claimed â†’ DELIVERED
    // (claim_delivery: OUT_FOR_DELIVERY â†’ claimed)
    // (PATCH status=DELIVERED con foto+firma)
    expect(TERMINAL_STATUSES).toContain('DELIVERED');
  });

  it('Pago antes de carga: paid â†’ carga â†’ OUT_FOR_DELIVERY directo', () => {
    // Cajero cobra antes de que almacÃ©n cargue
    const afterPaymentNoLoad = nextStatusAfterPayment('DELIVERY', false);
    expect(afterPaymentNoLoad).toBe('paid');

    // AlmacÃ©n carga y como ya estÃ¡ pagado, sale directo a ruta
    const afterLoadingPaid = nextStatusAfterLoading('DELIVERY', true);
    expect(afterLoadingPaid).toBe('OUT_FOR_DELIVERY');
  });

  it('Carga antes de pago: carga â†’ READY_TO_SHIP â†’ pago â†’ OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', () => {
    // AlmacÃ©n carga sin pago
    const afterLoadingNoPay = nextStatusAfterLoading('DELIVERY', false);
    expect(afterLoadingNoPay).toBe('READY_TO_SHIP');

    // Cajero cobra con carga lista
    const afterPaymentLoaded = nextStatusAfterPayment('DELIVERY', true);
    expect(afterPaymentLoaded).toBe('OUT_FOR_DELIVERY');
  });
});


describe('Order FSM â€” CAMINO 3: Pickup / Patio (PICKUP & PATIO)', () => {

  it('Flujo PICKUP: pending_payment â†’ carga â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP â†’ pago â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID â†’ DELIVERED', () => {
    // 1. Cliente solicita recolecciÃ³n
    const step1 = getInitialStatus(true, false);
    expect(step1).toBe('pending_payment');

    // 2. AlmacÃ©n prepara (sin pago)
    const step2 = nextStatusAfterLoading('PICKUP', false);
    expect(step2).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP');

    // 3. Cajero cobra con carga lista
    expect(CASHIER_READY_STATUSES).toContain('READY_FOR_PICKUP');
    const step3 = nextStatusAfterPayment('PICKUP', true);
    expect(step3).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID');

    // 4. Mostrador entrega â†’ DELIVERED
    expect(TERMINAL_STATUSES).toContain('DELIVERED');
  });

  it('Flujo PATIO: pending_payment â†’ carga â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP â†’ pago â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID â†’ DELIVERED', () => {
    // PATIO sigue exactamente la misma mÃ¡quina de estados que PICKUP
    const step2 = nextStatusAfterLoading('PATIO', false);
    expect(step2).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP');

    const step3 = nextStatusAfterPayment('PATIO', true);
    expect(step3).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID');
  });

  it('Pago antes de carga (PICKUP): paid â†’ carga â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID directo', () => {
    const afterPaymentNoLoad = nextStatusAfterPayment('PICKUP', false);
    expect(afterPaymentNoLoad).toBe('paid');

    const afterLoadingPaid = nextStatusAfterLoading('PICKUP', true);
    expect(afterLoadingPaid).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID');
  });

  it('Pago antes de carga (PATIO): paid â†’ carga â†’ READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID directo', () => {
    const afterPaymentNoLoad = nextStatusAfterPayment('PATIO', false);
    expect(afterPaymentNoLoad).toBe('paid');

    const afterLoadingPaid = nextStatusAfterLoading('PATIO', true);
    expect(afterLoadingPaid).toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID');
  });
});


describe('Order FSM â€” Flujos Transversales (CancelaciÃ³n, ExpiraciÃ³n)', () => {

  it('CancelaciÃ³n: cualquier estado no-terminal puede cancelarse', () => {
    const nonTerminal: OrderStatus[] = [
      'pending_payment', 'pending_confirmation', 'NIGHT_QUEUE',
      'PENDIENTE_LLEGADA', 'paid', 'PREPARANDO',
      'READY_TO_SHIP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID',
      'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'claimed'
    ];

    for (const status of nonTerminal) {
      expect(canCancel(status)).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('Estados terminales NO pueden cancelarse', () => {
    for (const status of TERMINAL_STATUSES) {
      expect(canCancel(status)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('ExpiraciÃ³n: solo estados con reserva activa pueden expirar', () => {
    // Estos estados tienen reserva de stock y expiresAt
    for (const status of EXPIRABLE_STATUSES) {
      expect(TERMINAL_STATUSES).not.toContain(status);
    }

    // Estados terminales nunca expiran
    for (const status of TERMINAL_STATUSES) {
      expect(EXPIRABLE_STATUSES).not.toContain(status);
    }
  });

  it('ExpiraciÃ³n detecta reservas vencidas (confirmedAt = null)', () => {
    const now = new Date();
    const expiredOrder: OrderState = {
      status: 'pending_payment',
      deliveryType: 'DELIVERY',
      confirmedAt: null,             // NO pagado
      isLoaded: false,
      vendedorId: null,
      assignedDriverId: null,
      expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 60000), // VenciÃ³ hace 1 min
    };

    // Condiciones del GET /api/orders para detectar expiraciÃ³n:
    const isExpired = expiredOrder.expiresAt !== null
      && expiredOrder.expiresAt <= now
      && expiredOrder.confirmedAt === null
      && EXPIRABLE_STATUSES.includes(expiredOrder.status);

    expect(isExpired).toBe(true);
  });

  it('Orden pagada NO expira aunque tenga expiresAt en el pasado', () => {
    const now = new Date();
    const paidOrder: OrderState = {
      status: 'paid',
      deliveryType: 'DELIVERY',
      confirmedAt: new Date(),     // YA pagado
      isLoaded: false,
      vendedorId: 'v1',
      assignedDriverId: null,
      expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 60000),
    };

    // confirmedAt != null â†’ NO expira
    const isExpired = paidOrder.expiresAt !== null
      && paidOrder.expiresAt <= now
      && paidOrder.confirmedAt === null;

    expect(isExpired).toBe(false);
  });
});


describe('Order FSM â€” ValidaciÃ³n de Roles por AcciÃ³n', () => {
  const cashierRoles = ['sales', 'billing', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
  const loadingRoles = ['carga_descarga', 'inventory', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
  const deliveryRoles = ['driver', 'carga_descarga', 'admin', 'superadmin'];
  const pickupRoles = ['pickup', 'inventory', 'carga_descarga', 'driver', 'admin', 'superadmin'];

  it('Solo roles de caja pueden cobrar', () => {
    expect(cashierRoles).toContain('sales');
    expect(cashierRoles).toContain('billing');
    expect(cashierRoles).not.toContain('driver');
    expect(cashierRoles).not.toContain('carga_descarga');
    expect(cashierRoles).not.toContain('client');
  });

  it('Solo roles de almacÃ©n pueden preparar', () => {
    expect(loadingRoles).toContain('carga_descarga');
    expect(loadingRoles).toContain('inventory');
    expect(loadingRoles).not.toContain('sales');
    expect(loadingRoles).not.toContain('driver');
    expect(loadingRoles).not.toContain('client');
  });

  it('Solo roles de reparto pueden tomar rutas', () => {
    expect(deliveryRoles).toContain('driver');
    expect(deliveryRoles).toContain('carga_descarga');
    expect(deliveryRoles).not.toContain('sales');
    expect(deliveryRoles).not.toContain('client');
  });

  it('Roles autorizados pueden entregar en mostrador (pickup)', () => {
    expect(pickupRoles).toContain('pickup');
    expect(pickupRoles).toContain('inventory');
    expect(pickupRoles).not.toContain('sales');
    expect(pickupRoles).not.toContain('client');
  });

  it('Admin y superadmin tienen acceso a todas las acciones', () => {
    for (const role of ['admin', 'superadmin']) {
      expect(cashierRoles).toContain(role);
      expect(loadingRoles).toContain(role);
      expect(deliveryRoles).toContain(role);
      expect(pickupRoles).toContain(role);
    }
  });
});


describe('Order FSM â€” Consistencia de la MÃ¡quina de Estados', () => {

  it('Toda combinaciÃ³n deliveryType Ã— isPaid produce un estado vÃ¡lido en complete_loading', () => {
    const deliveryTypes: DeliveryType[] = ['LOCAL', 'DELIVERY', 'PICKUP', 'PATIO'];
    const validLoadingResults: OrderStatus[] = [
      'COMPLETED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'READY_TO_SHIP',
      'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID'
    ];

    for (const dt of deliveryTypes) {
      for (const paid of [true, false]) {
        const result = nextStatusAfterLoading(dt, paid);
        expect(validLoadingResults).toContain(result);
      }
    }
  });

  it('Toda combinaciÃ³n deliveryType Ã— isLoaded produce un estado vÃ¡lido en cashier_payment', () => {
    const deliveryTypes: DeliveryType[] = ['LOCAL', 'DELIVERY', 'PICKUP', 'PATIO'];
    const validPaymentResults: OrderStatus[] = [
      'paid', 'COMPLETED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID'
    ];

    for (const dt of deliveryTypes) {
      for (const loaded of [true, false]) {
        const result = nextStatusAfterPayment(dt, loaded);
        expect(validPaymentResults).toContain(result);
      }
    }
  });

  it('NingÃºn estado terminal aparece como estado inicial', () => {
    for (const asReq of [true, false]) {
      for (const night of [true, false]) {
        const initial = getInitialStatus(asReq, night);
        expect(TERMINAL_STATUSES).not.toContain(initial);
      }
    }
  });

  it('DELIVERY nunca termina en READY_FOR_PICKUP* y PICKUP nunca termina en READY_TO_SHIP', () => {
    // Delivery no produce estados de pickup
    expect(nextStatusAfterLoading('DELIVERY', false)).not.toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP');
    expect(nextStatusAfterLoading('DELIVERY', true)).not.toBe('READY_FOR_PICKUP_PAID');

    // Pickup no produce estados de delivery
    expect(nextStatusAfterLoading('PICKUP', false)).not.toBe('READY_TO_SHIP');
    expect(nextStatusAfterLoading('PICKUP', true)).not.toBe('OUT_FOR_DELIVERY');
  });

  it('Stock se descuenta atÃ³micamente al crear (venta directa) o al cashier_payment (solicitud)', () => {
    // En el cÃ³digo real:
    // - Venta directa (!isCashierRequest): stock se descuenta en POST /api/orders transacciÃ³n
    // - Solicitud (isCashierRequest): stock NO se descuenta al crear, se descuenta en cashier_payment
    // Verificamos que la lÃ³gica de decisiÃ³n es correcta:
    const directSale = { asRequest: false };
    const requestSale = { asRequest: true };

    // Venta directa: descuenta inmediato
    expect(directSale.asRequest).toBe(false);  // â†’ stock.decrement en POST

    // Solicitud: no descuenta al crear
    expect(requestSale.asRequest).toBe(true);  // â†’ stock.decrement en cashier_payment
  });
});
